\"Captain\" Cookie.text: "Captain" Cookie is an elite murloc in the Deadmines. He fights with [Cookie's Tenderizer].

Abyssal Council.text: The Abyssal Council are Twilight's Hammer leaders in Silithus. They control the cult through arcane wind stones set up in the Twilight's Hammer camps there.

Achellios the Banished.text: Achellios the Banished is a rare centaur who patrols the plateau in eastern Thousand Needles alongside three Galak Packhounds. He is on a 5-8 hour respawn timer.

Aethalas.text: Aethalas is a night elf Warsong Gulch battlemaster located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

Agon.text: Agon is a ghostly boar found wandering the Brightwood Grove in Duskwood.

Air elemental.text: Air elementals are creatures made of air, wind and storms. On Azeroth they are led by the Windlord Thunderaan.

Alexandros Mograine.text: Alexandros Mograine, the Ashbringer, was a Highlord of the Order of the Silver Hand and led paladins against the Horde in the Second War. During the Third War he purified a corrupted orb from the siege of Blackrock Spire into the weapon that became the Ashbringer.

Amani Empire.text: The Amani Empire, also called the Amani Empire of Zul'Aman, is a forest troll empire in northern Lordaeron. It took its name from the Amani, the strongest of the forest troll tribes that founded it long before the Great Sundering. The empire was crushed in the Troll Wars.

Amani tribe.text: The Amani are a tribe of forest trolls who founded the Amani Empire in northeastern ancient Kalimdor, with Zul'Aman as their capital. Akil'zon is the loa of the Amani tribe and its ruling family.

Ambassador Malcin.text: Ambassador Malcin is an undead found near Razorfen Downs in the Barrens. He was a representative from the Scourge to the Death's Head tribe, the ruling body of the quilboars of Kalimdor, offering aid in the quilboars' attempts to take control of the Barrens in exchange for their aid to the Scourge. After retrieving a letter from Malcin to Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and taking it to the Undercity, Varimathras sent Horde adventurers back to the Barrens to take the Ambassador's head and return it to him.

Anachronos.text: Anachronos the Ancient is a bronze dragon, the heir of Nozdormu the Timeless One, and leader of the Brood of Nozdormu. He was an important figure in the War of the Shifting Sands, the Ahn'Qiraj War.

Anaya Dawnrunner.text: Anaya Dawnrunner is a night elf ghost found in Darkshore.

Ancient Stone Keeper.text: Ancient Stone Keeper is a stone keeper built by the titans to help protect Uldaman from invaders and to oversee daily operations while Ironaya and Archaedas slumber.

Ander Germaine.text: Ander Germaine is a human warrior trainer located at the Command Center in Old Town in Stormwind City.

Angelas Moonbreeze.text: Angelas Moonbreeze is a night elf quest giver located at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. She had a pet cat named Jacob.

Anub'Rekhan.text: Anub'Rekhan is the first boss of the Arachnid Quarter in Naxxramas.

Anubisath.text: Anubisaths are titan-forged giants made of obsidian, with heads shaped like jackals. They were assigned to guard the fortress of Ahn'Qiraj, but were enslaved by the qiraji to serve the Old God C'Thun.

Apothecary Cylla.text: Apothecary Cylla is at Direhorn Post to show good faith to the Grimtotem tribe of tauren. She's a Forsaken member, but she's hostile to the Horde and to other Forsaken as well.

Aqir.text: The aqir are an ancient insectoid race that arose from the Old Gods during Azeroth's primordial era. When the Old Gods' empire was defeated, the aqir were driven underground, where they stayed until they were reawakened by Kith'ix. Obsessed with wiping out all non-insectoid life on Kalimdor, they went to war with the trolls before being defeated and split into separate insectoid peoples, including the qiraji of Ahn'Qiraj.

Aquementas the Unchained.text: Aquementas the Unchained is a water elemental in Tanaris. It is summoned with the [Book of Aquor] at the Circle of Aquementas.

Arathi tribe.text: The Arathi were an ancient human tribe. Led by King Thoradin, they founded Arathor, the first human civilization, by uniting the other tribes of the Eastern Kingdoms. The Arathi were conquerors, but they extended cooperation and equality to the tribes they defeated, which made humanity strong.

Arcane Chimaerok.text: An Arcane Chimaerok was one of three types of chimaeras that lived on the Isle of Dread off the coast of Feralas. They dropped Chimaerok Tenderloins, needed for the quest Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops during the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Arei.text: Arei was an Ancient of War quest giver located in Irontree Woods in Felwood. He appeared when you play the [Flute of the Ancients] in Irontree Woods.

Atal'ai tribe.text: The Atal'ai are a tribe of trolls who worship the Blood God Hakkar and are based in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. They are green or white skinned, with green, purple or white hair. They practice forbidden magic, including necromancy Hakkar taught them for their loyalty.

Atiesh (demon).text: Atiesh was a summoned demon boss encountered in Stratholme as part of the Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian quest line. It was summoned on "consecrated earth" in the Festival Lane, between Elders' Square and King's Square.

Axebeak.text: Axebeaks are birds found in Azeroth. They are omnivorous, and the edges of their beaks are particularly sharp.

Azj'Tordin.text: Azj'Tordin is a Shen'dralar night elf located at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas. He fled Eldre'Thalas (Dire Maul) and the Shen'dralar, giving up his immortality for freedom. The imp Pusillin then stole his [Book of Incantations] and [Crescent Key] and took them back to Eldre'Thalas.

Badger.text: Badgers are sturdy, short-legged mammals that come out at night. They are like wolverines.

Bale.text: Bale is a tauren general goods vendor located at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

Balnazzar (Classic).text: Balnazzar hides under the guise of Saidan Dathrohan, Grand Crusader of the Scarlet Crusade.

Balzaphon.text: Balzaphon is a lich mini-boss in Stratholme that appears during the Scourge Invasion.

Bandit (mob).text: Bandits are human mobs found in several spots around Elwynn Forest, including Mirror Lake and Mirror Lake Orchard, the house at Thunder Falls, a hut north of Crystal Lake, southeast of Goldshire, the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, and east of Ridgepoint Tower.

Banshee.text: Banshees are undead elf and human women without bodies, known for their unholy screams and for possessing the bodies of their enemies. Many were made when the Scourge invaded Quel'Thalas in the Third War and slaughtered its high elves. Many banshees joined the Forsaken once they were freed from the Lich King.

Barbed Gasgill.text: Barbed Gasgills are neutral level 42-43 puffer fish located in Thousand Needles.

Baroness Anastari.text: Baroness Anastari is a banshee mini-boss found in Stratholme. She was a baroness in life before the Scourge killed her, and now serves the Lich King.

Bat.text: Bats are nocturnal, flying mammals found in every region of Azeroth. They feed on carrion.

Bat rider.text: Bat riders are riders mounted on giant bats. Darkspear troll bat riders are fire-obsessed and are often used for reconnaissance. The Forsaken use bat riders of their own, known as dread-riders.

Battle Boar.text: Battle Boars are boars located in Razorfen Kraul.

Belnistrasz.text: Belnistrasz is a red dragon quest giver found in Razorfen Downs. He appears as a human and doesn't care whether anyone's loyalties lie with the Horde or the Alliance.

Bengor.text: Bengor is an orc quest giver located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Beram Skychaser.text: Beram Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer located on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

Bhag'thera.text: Bhag'thera is a panther found patrolling through Bambala in Stranglethorn Vale.

Black dragonflight.text: The black dragonflight is a group of black dragons that protect and ward the earth. The titan Khaz'goroth charged them with guarding the deep places of the world. They were led by their Aspect, Neltharion the Earth-Warder, until the Old Gods corrupted him and turned him and most of his flight into their pawns.

Black Drake.text: Black Drakes are black drakes located in the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Black Empire.text: The Black Empire was a dark civilization the Old Gods built after arriving on primordial Azeroth. It ruled much of the world after the Elemental Lords failed to stop them. The empire was eventually destroyed by the titan-forged.

Blacksmith Verringtan.text: Blacksmith Avery Verringtan is a human found in Hillsbrad Fields in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Blackwing Lair lab packs.text: The "lab packs" are the trash pulls in the Alchemy Lab of Blackwing Lair, beyond Broodlord Lashlayer. They're Technicians, Warlocks, Spellbinders, and Overseers.

Bleak Worg.text: Bleak Worgs are found in Shadowfang Keep.

Bleakheart Hellcaller.text: Bleakheart Hellcallers are satyrs found in Satyrnaar in Ashenvale.

Blind Hunter.text: The Blind Hunter is a rare albino bat found deep in Razorfen Kraul, farther in than the regular Kraul Bats.

Blindlight tribe.text: The Blindlight tribe is a tribe of murlocs living in Blackfathom Deeps. Their leader Gelihast forced his way into the deeps and killed nearly a dozen Twilight's Hammer cultists there. The cultists let him stay, and he built a shrine to the Old Gods.

Blood Steward of Kirtonos.text: The Blood Steward of Kirtonos is a succubus found in the Reliquary in Scholomance. She's a source of [Blood of Innocents], but you have to clear nearly the entire Reliquary to reach her.

Bloodaxe Legion.text: The Bloodaxe Legion is a division of Rend Blackhand's Blackrock orcs, based mostly in the lower levels of Blackrock Spire. Most of its members fight in melee with axes and swords, with only a few spellcasters among them.

Bloodfang Berserker.text: Bloodfang Berserkers are members of the Bloodfang pack, found in Shadowfang Keep.

Bloodfeather harpies.text: The Bloodfeathers are red-and-white-plumaged harpies found around the Oracle Glade in Teldrassil. When the Oracle Tree tried to send a messenger to Darnassus with a report, the harpies attacked and killed him.

Bloodhoof tribe.text: The Bloodhoof tribe of tauren live in the grasslands of Mulgore. They are part of the Horde, led by Cairne Bloodhoof, who rules from Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

Bloodlord Mandokir (Classic).text: Bloodlord Mandokir is a boss in Zul'Gurub and the first optional encounter there, since he doesn't empower Hakkar the way the High Priests do. He fights alongside his mount, and grows stronger each time he kills a player.

Bloodmage Thalnos.text: Bloodmage Thalnos is a skeleton mini-boss found in the Graveyard of the Scarlet Monastery, just below the staircase at the far end.

Bloodpetal Lasher.text: Bloodpetal Lashers are bloodpetals found in the Un'Goro Crater.

Bloodsail Corsair.text: Bloodsail Corsairs are humans found in Stranglethorn Vale.

Bloodscalp Berserker.text: Bloodscalp Berserkers are jungle trolls found at Zuuldaia Ruins in Stranglethorn Vale.

Bloodscalp Shaman.text: Bloodscalp Shaman are jungle trolls found at Bal'lal Ruins in Stranglethorn Vale.

Bloodscalp tribe.text: The Bloodscalp are a tribe of jungle trolls that split off from the Gurubashi Empire after the defeat of Hakkar the Soulflayer. The various troll tribes claimed territory across Stranglethorn Vale and began fighting each other. The Bloodscalp settled in the northwest of Stranglethorn and still fight off outsiders, including the nearby Skullsplitter tribe, to hold their land.

Bloodscalp Witch Doctor.text: Bloodscalp Witch Doctors are jungle trolls found at Zuuldaia Ruins in Stranglethorn Vale.

Bloodseeker Bat.text: Bloodseeker Bats are bats found in Zul'Gurub.

Blue dragonflight.text: The blue dragonflight is a group of blue dragons led by Malygos, tasked by the titan Norgannon with watching over the flow of magic on Azeroth. Malygos and his Prime Consort Sindragosa ruled the flight until the War of the Ancients, when Deathwing used the Demon Soul to kill most of the blue dragons.

Bluegill Warrior.text: Bluegill Warriors are murlocs found in the Bluegill Marsh in the Wetlands.

Boahn.text: Boahn is a rare night elf who spawns in front of the entrance to Wailing Caverns, near the pond.

Boar Spirit.text: Boar Spirits are boar ghosts in Razorfen Kraul, summoned by Aggem Thorncurse. They appear after Groyat, the Blind Hunter, is killed.

Bog beast.text: Bog beasts are large plant creatures of temperate marshes and damp caves. They are also called fen creepers, spore beasts or cave beasts.

Bone Chewer.text: Bone Chewers are ghouls found in the Raven Hill Cemetery of Duskwood.

Bookie Herod.text: Bookie Herod is a human found at Kurzen's Compound in Stranglethorn Vale. He was Kurzen's logistics officer, who knew about the running of the compound and the expedition.

Bough of Corruption.text: The Bough of Corruption is what's left of Xavius's corruption of Teldrassil. Xavius, helped by the Old Gods, entered and corrupted the Emerald Dream, then later corrupted Fandral Staghelm as he planted the seeds that grew into Teldrassil.

Boulderfist clan.text: The Boulderfist clan is a clan of ogres that live throughout the Arathi Highlands. Their main bases are Boulder'gor and Boulderfist Hall. They once held part of Stromgarde Keep before the Alliance retook it.

Boulderfist Mauler.text: Boulderfist Maulers are ogres found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.

Boulderfist Shaman.text: Boulderfist Shaman are ogres found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.

Brainwashed Noble.text: The Brainwashed Noble is a rare human that spawns near the undead section of the caves outside the Deadmines instance. He appears to be a member of the House of Nobles of Stormwind who was brought under the control of the Defias Brotherhood.

Branchlord Aldrus.text: Branchlord Aldrus is an ancient located in the Arathi Highlands.

Brigitte Abbendis.text: High General Brigitte Abbendis was one of the founders of the original Scarlet Crusade. She was the daughter of the former High General Abbendis.

Bristleback tribe.text: The Bristleback tribe is a tribe of quilboar that live in Mulgore and the Barrens. The Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine are at war with the tauren of Camp Narache and have pushed into Red Cloud Mesa.

Bronze dragonflight.text: The bronze dragonflight is a group of bronze dragons led by Nozdormu. The titan Aman'Thul gave Nozdormu and his brood the ability to travel through time and mastery over temporal magic. They are usually stoic and detached from current events, and rarely deal with mortals except to protect the one true timeline.

Bronzebeard clan.text: The Bronzebeard clan is the leading clan among the Ironforge dwarves of Khaz Modan; Ironforge dwarves are also known as Bronzebeard dwarves. During the War of the Three Hammers, they led the dwarves of Ironforge against Thaurissan and the Dark Iron clan.

Brood of Nozdormu (drake).text: The Brood of Nozdormu are bronze drakes found flying over Silithus.

Burning Blade clan.text: The Burning Blade clan is a demonic cult, best known for its blademasters. It fought in the First and Second Wars as part of the Old Horde, but was eventually consumed by demonic corruption. Its blademasters later swore to free themselves from demonic control and joined the New Horde under Warchief Thrall.

Burning Blade Coven.text: The Burning Blade Coven is in the mountains on the northern border of the Valley of Trials, an orc and troll starting area. Imps and other weak demons live in the cave there.

Burning Exile.text: Burning Exiles are fire elementals found at the Circle of West Binding in the Arathi Highlands.

Burning Legion.text: The Burning Legion is a vast army of demons and corrupted races that wants to destroy all life. The fallen titan Sargeras created it.

Candlestick Mage.text: Candlestick Mages are humans located in Scholomance.

Captain Melrache.text: Captain Melrache is a human member of the Scarlet Crusade stationed in the Scarlet Watch Post, a ruined scout tower in Tirisfal Glades. He is a part of Tirisfal Regional Command.

Captain Stillwater.text: Captain Stillwater is a gnome member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers in Stranglethorn Vale. He is the captain of the Damsel's Luck, and Fleet Master Seahorn wants him dead.

Captain Wyrmak.text: Lord Captain Wyrmak is a rare dragonspawn in the Swamp of Sorrows, in the area where the drake Somnus patrols.

Carp.text: The carp is a fish. In the game it is a cooking ingredient and a quest item.

Carrion bird.text: Carrion birds are a hunter pet family made up mostly of large, carnivorous scavenger birds.

Centaur.text: Centaur are a warlike race with human upper bodies and the lower bodies of horses. There are two separate centaur civilizations, each split into clans led by their own khans, though they share a single culture.

Charlga Razorflank.text: Charlga Razorflank <The Crone> is an elite quilboar boss in Razorfen Kraul. She's the figurehead leader of the Death's Head tribe, but Amnennar the Coldbringer actually controls it.

Chef Grual.text: Chef Grual is a human quest giver in the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, Duskwood. He secretly puts Gooey Spider Legs in the [Dusky Crab Cakes].

Chicken.text: Chickens are domesticated birds found in many parts of Azeroth.

Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle.text: Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle is a quilboar and the leader of the Bristleback tribe, which lived in Brambleblade Ravine in Mulgore. The Bristlebacks have started invading the lands guarded by the tauren at Camp Narache. Brave Windfeather wanted the chief's head.

Chillwind Chimaera.text: Chillwind Chimaeras are chimaeras found in an area west of the Hidden Grove in Winterspring. Skinners can skin them for [Chimera Leather].

Chimaera.text: A chimaera is a large flying creature with two heads. It looks like a mix of a dragon and a wyvern.

Chimaerok.text: A Chimaerok was one of three types of chimaeras that lived on the Isle of Dread off the coast of Feralas. They dropped Chimaerok Tenderloins, needed for [60] Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops, part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands questline for the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Chimaerok Devourer.text: A Chimaerok Devourer was one of three types of chimaeras that lived on the Isle of Dread off the coast of Feralas. They dropped Chimaerok Tenderloins, needed for [60] Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops, part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands questline for the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Cho'gall.text: Cho'gall is a powerful ogre mage, Initiate of the Fifth Circle of the Shadow Council, and Chieftain of the Twilight's Hammer clan. He survived when Gul'dan was torn apart by demons at the end of the Second War, then fled to Kalimdor and took refuge in the ruined city of Ahn'Qiraj, where he became a servant of the Old Gods.

Chromatic dragonflight.text: The chromatic dragonflight of Blackrock Spire was created by Nefarian's experiments with the blood of dragons from the other dragonflights. Nefarian was trying to follow in his father Deathwing's footsteps by creating a chromatic dragonflight of his own. Most of the experiments failed: many whelps died before hatching, and the survivors were unstable and short-lived.

Clam.text: A clam is a creature that acts like a container item, usually fished from the sea or dropped by coastal mobs. It usually holds clam meat, used in cooking, and sometimes a pearl, used in a few profession recipes.

Cliffwatcher Longhorn.text: Cliffwatcher Longhorn is a tauren located in Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. His brother is Nataka Longhorn.

Cobalt Mageweaver.text: Cobalt Mageweavers are blue dragonspawn found in Winterspring. They occupy Mazthoril.

Colossus.text: A colossus is a kind of mountain giant. Its flesh is stone, and large crystals grow from its shoulders, back and head.

Compact Harvest Reaper.text: A Compact Harvest Reaper is a harvest golem summoned by goblin mobs: Engineer Whirleygig in the Barrens Venture Co. and Machine Smith in the Stonetalon Mountains Venture Co.

Condor.text: Condors are a type of large vulture found in Azeroth.

Core hound.text: A core hound, also spelled corehound, is a four-legged fire elemental shaped like a massive dog, with rows of flaming teeth in its mouth. Core hounds serve the Firelord and his minions.

Corrupt Spirit Beast.text: Corrupt Spirit Beast appears as a bear, spirit wolves, and a corrupted treant in Ashenvale.

Councilman Stark I'ylar.text: The ghost of Councilman Stark I'ylar stands in the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains. He and the other ghosts in the ruins seem to relive moments in their lives, talking to a crowd of Highborne Citizens.

Cow.text: Cows are the most common kind of large domesticated ungulate, bred for their milk. Pygmy cows were originally bred to make milk more palatable for gnomes.

Crab.text: Crabs, also called crawlers, are small crustaceans usually found along the coastline, though they can survive away from the ocean for a while. They're not usually hostile, and they ignore passers-by.

Cracked Golem.text: Cracked Golems can be found at Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore.

Cragjaw.text: Cragjaw is a giant grouper located in Cragpool Lake in Stonetalon Mountains.

Cresting Exile.text: Cresting Exiles are water elementals that can be found at the Circle of East Binding in the Arathi Highlands.

Cresting Goliath.text: Cresting Goliath is a water elemental located in the Circle of East Binding in the Arathi Highlands.

Crewman Coilspan.text: Crewman Coilspan is a goblin crew member aboard The Cloudkisser, a zeppelin that runs to Tirisfal Glades.

Crewman Spinwheel.text: Crewman Spinwheel is a goblin crew member aboard The Cloudkisser, a zeppelin that runs to Tirisfal Glades.

Crewman Stembolt.text: Crewman Stembolt is a goblin crew member aboard The Cloudkisser, a zeppelin that runs to Tirisfal Glades.

Crimson Bodyguard.text: The Crimson Bodyguards were level 57-58 elite human members of the Crimson Legion who traveled from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme in the Eastern Plaguelands. They escorted the Crimson Courier from Stratholme, through Plaguewood, and fought through Corin's Crossing. Nathanos Blightcaller wanted the Courier's documents.

Crimson Courier.text: The Crimson Courier was a level 60 elite human member of the Crimson Legion who traveled from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme in the Eastern Plaguelands, escorted by level 57-58 elite Crimson Bodyguards. She traveled from Stratholme, through Plaguewood, and fought through Corin's Crossing.

Crimson legion.text: The Crimson Legion was a group of Scarlet Crusaders led by Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan, based in the Crusaders' Square of Stratholme. They fought the Scourge across the Eastern and Western Plaguelands. Their tabards had an alternating white-and-red pattern with a white version of the Scarlet flame in the middle.

Crithto (dog).text: Crithto is an elite pug that can be found continuously running inside the Stormwind Keep gardens, in the human capital of Stormwind City. Sometimes he leaves the keep, reaching the Trade District, Cathedral Square, and the Dwarven District, before returning to the Keep.

Critter.text: Critters, also called ambient creatures, are small animals or vermin included for ambiance. They give no experience and little or no loot, and you can't target them with the tab key.

Crocolisk.text: Crocolisks, also called crocs, are six-legged reptiles that live in fresh and salt water across Azeroth, in wetlands, rivers, lakes and coastal waters. Some make their way into city sewers.

Crusty.text: Crusty is a rare crab found off the coast of Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.

Crypt Walker.text: Crypt Walkers are crypt fiends found in the Terrorweb Tunnel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Dagran Thaurissan.text: Dagran Thaurissan was the Emperor of the Dark Iron clan. His wife was Moira Thaurissan, the estranged daughter of King Magni Bronzebeard. He pledged the Dark Iron clan to the elemental lord Ragnaros, who his ancestor Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan had summoned to the mortal plane.

Dalinda Malem.text: Dalinda Malem is a night elf quest giver in Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace. She was a noble of a Darnassian merchant family, House Malem.

Dark Horde.text: The Dark Horde was a renegade group of orcs, trolls, ogres and goblins in Blackrock Spire, made up mostly of the Blackrock and Dragonmaw clans. Nefarian of the black dragonflight led them, with Rend Blackhand ruling as the self-styled Warchief. Unlike Thrall's New Horde, they stayed loyal to the old Horde's demonic bloodlust.

Dark Iron Army.text: The Dark Iron Army is an army of Dark Irons based in Blackrock Depths. They outnumber the Kargath Expeditionary Force and have defeated its 109th Division. Ragnaros's minions have empowered them further.

Dark Iron clan.text: The Dark Iron clan, also called the Dark Iron Nation, is a dwarf clan once ruled by Sorcerer-thane Thaurissan. They fought the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer clans for control of Ironforge in the War of the Three Hammers. The accidental summoning of Ragnaros ended that war and left the Dark Irons enslaved to the Firelord.

Dark Iron dwarf.text: Dark Iron dwarves, also called dark dwarves, are a kind of dwarf. Most belong to the Dark Iron clan. Some belong to other groups, such as the Thorium Brotherhood or the Venture Company.

Dark Scar clan.text: The Dark Scar clan was an ancient orcish or ogre clan destroyed in the Blood River war. Kash'drakor, who wielded the blade Serathil, was the only known person to take part in it. Little else is known about the clan.

Dark troll.text: Dark trolls are a rare, gray-skinned group of trolls that once lived under Mount Hyjal and other parts of western and central Kalimdor. A group of dark trolls living by the Well of Eternity evolved into the first night elves. The only dark troll tribe seen in recent times, the Shadowtooth clan, was destroyed by the Twilight's Hammer cult.

Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.text: Darkreaver's Fallen Charger is found in Scholomance. It was the steed of Death Knight Darkreaver, and a paladin holding the [Charger's Redeemed Soul] and a [Blessed Arcanite Barding] can redeem it as their own mount.

Darkspear tribe.text: The Darkspear tribe is a tribe of jungle trolls that's part of the Horde. During Warchief Thrall's exodus from Lordaeron, the Horde rescued the Darkspears from the naga sea witch Zar'jira. The Darkspears allied with the Horde out of gratitude.

Darktusk Boar.text: Darktusk Boars are boars found near Ambermill in Silverpine Forest.

Darnassian Army.text: The Darnassian Army is the collective military force of the night elves. Its largest part is the Sentinels, warrior women who serve as both guards and front-line troops. In war, they also rely on druids, wisps, ancients, hippogryphs, chimaera, treants and dryads.

Darnassus Firebreather.text: Darnassus Firebreathers were night elves located in Teldrassil.

Dawnstrider tribe.text: The Dawnstrider tribe of tauren live in the Mulgore region of Kalimdor. They tend to have a lighter brown skin tone than other tauren, and have a talent for enchanting.

Dead-Tooth Jack.text: Dead-Tooth Jack is a human found to the east of Ridgepoint Tower in southeastern Elwynn Forest.

Deadwind ogres.text: The Deadwind ogres are a group of ogres in Deadwind Pass, living in an area called the Vice. They fight the Deadwind Widows there, for reasons that aren't known.

Death's Head Seer.text: Death's Head Seers are quilboar located in Razorfen Kraul.

Death's Head tribe.text: The Death's Head tribe is a group of undead quilboars in Razorfen Downs, controlled by the Scourge and led by the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer. They were the first major Scourge outpost on Kalimdor, and are allied with the Razorfen tribe.

Deathguard Barth.text: Deathguard Barth is one of the Forsaken deathguards aboard The Cloudkisser zeppelin in Tirisfal Glades.

Deathguard Hicks.text: Deathguard Hicks is one of the Forsaken deathguards aboard The Cloudkisser zeppelin in Tirisfal Glades.

Defias Bandit.text: Defias Bandits are human members of the Defias Brotherhood found across Elwynn Forest.

Defias Blackguard.text: Defias Blackguards are elite humans of the Defias Brotherhood found in the Deadmines. They guard Edwin VanCleef and use Stealth to ambush intruders.

Defias Brotherhood.text: The Defias Brotherhood, founded by Edwin VanCleef, is an order of former stonemasons, assassins, thieves and pirates who wear red bandanas. They once sought to overthrow the Kingdom of Stormwind from their base in the Deadmines of Westfall, building a massive juggernaut to destroy the city. Adventurers sent by Gryan Stoutmantle defeated them before they could finish it.

Defias Henchman.text: Defias Henchmen are humans of the Defias Brotherhood who could be found in the Deadmines.

Defias Messenger.text: The Defias Messenger is a Defias Brotherhood member who walks the western road between Moonbrook and the Jangolode Mine in Westfall. He spawns in front of the blacksmith's building in Moonbrook, then travels north through the Gold Coast Quarry to the Jangolode Mine and back.

Defias Pillager.text: Defias Pillagers are humans found in Moonbrook in Westfall. They hit hard with fireballs, and are often found clustered together with other Pillagers and nearby Defias Looters.

Defias Reaper.text: Defias Reapers are harvest golems no longer under the control of their builders, found in the Goblin Foundry of the Deadmines. This golem can be mounted.

Defias Rebel (mob).text: Defias Rebels are humans located in Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest. They are found accompanying Defias Ringleaders, Defias Mages, and Duncon Ratsbon.

Defias Rioter.text: Defias Rioters could be found in Stormwind City, breaking out of the Stockade every half hour. Guards made quick work of them, but the breakouts made the area unsafe for low-level players.

Defias Watcher.text: Defias Watchers are harvest golems no longer under the control of their builders, found in the Goblin Foundry of the Deadmines. This golem can be mounted.

Defias Worker.text: Defias Workers were humans of the Defias Brotherhood found in the original Deadmines. They weren't elite, but there were many of them, and a patrol could overwhelm a group whose tank had lost armor, or run off to bring reinforcements.

Defilers Envoy.text: Defilers Envoys were Forsaken recruiters for Arathi Basin, found in Orgrimmar.

Demi-human.text: Demi-human is a term for certain humanoid races, including dwarves, high elves and orcs. Uther the Lightbringer spent the years between the Second and Third War defending Lordaeron from demi-human uprisings.

Demon.text: Demons are immortal beings tied to the Twisting Nether. Most of them feed on magic and life. They like to cause suffering and spread corruption.

Demon cult.text: During the reign of the Burning Legion, mortals who followed demonic ways gained power unlike any they'd known. Though that power was taken from them, some still meet in secret to practice demonology and summon demons from the Twisting Nether.

Demon of the Orb.text: The Demon of the Orb is a felguard summoned by Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh. It was captured in an [Infernal Orb] by a Burning Blade summoner in Desolace.

Deranged Plaguefiend.text: Deranged Plaguefiends are geists located in Bashal'Aran in Darkshore during In Darkest Night.

Dermot.text: Dermot is a Forsaken who stole the Bloodstone Wedge from Magus Wordeen Voidglare as part of an attempt to defect from his people. Alongside Alina and Ricter, and led by Kegan Darkmar, he left the Undercity and helped steal Bloodstone Artifacts from a secure vault before fleeing to the ruins of the Lordamere Internment Camp in the Alterac Mountains.

Deserter Lieutenant.text: Deserter Lieutenant is a human, once a lieutenant in the Theramore Guard, who deserted and now attacks anyone nearby.

Detheroc.text: The dreadlord Detheroc and his brothers, Balnazzar and Varimathras, stayed in Lordaeron to watch over the Legion's holdings when the rest of the Legion left for Kalimdor. Detheroc led the three Dreadlord Insurgents, though he wasn't the most powerful of them. He had a large, soft belly and tiny eyes.

Deviate Dreadfang.text: Deviate Dreadfangs can be found in Wailing Caverns. Taming one teaches a hunter [Lightning Breath] Rank 2, which costs 5 points to train into your other pets.

Deviate Slayer.text: Deviate Slayers are raptors that can be found outside the instanced portion of the Wailing Caverns.

Deviate Venomwing.text: Deviate Venomwings are wind serpents that can be found in the Wailing Caverns. Taming one teaches a hunter [Lightning Breath] Rank 2, which costs 5 points to train into your other pets.

Devilsaur.text: Devilsaurs are huge dinosaurs found in Un'Goro Crater. A few can also be found in the Burning Steppes.

Dextren Ward.text: Dextren Ward was a level 26 elite human mini-boss in the Stormwind Stockade. His fear was especially dangerous in the Stockade's small, cramped rooms, so players usually cleared the nearby mobs before fighting him.

Diamond Head.text: Diamond Head is a makrura in the sea around Sardor Isle.

Diemetradon.text: Diemetradons are dinosaurs with two large sail-like fins along their backs, found mainly in Un'Goro Crater. There are also subterranean diemetradons in Maraudon.

Digmaster Shovelphlange.text: Digmaster Shovelphlange is a rare elite goblin found just outside the Uldaman instance in the Badlands.

Dinosaur.text: Dinosaurs, also called dinos, are large reptiles found mostly in tropical areas, especially Un'Goro Crater in southern Kalimdor.

Doctor Weavil.text: Doctor Weavil is an elite undead gnome located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. He was part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain. He has several Minions of Weavil scattered around his compound, all of which appear to be under his mind control.

Donkey.text: Donkeys are pack animals similar to horses. Orcs in the Horde are known to cook and eat them. A mule is the offspring of a male donkey and a female horse.

Doomguard.text: Doomguard are winged demons who serve the Burning Legion with great fervor, and once served as Archimonde's personal escort. They command the Legion's front-line forces. They use fire magic, dark curses and their weapons.

Dorn Plainstalker.text: Dorn Plainstalker is a tauren quest giver in the Weathered Nook in Thousand Needles. To reach him, head north from Freewind Post to the cliffs overlooking the needles, then follow the cliffs east to a ramp leading up.

Dragon whelp.text: Dragon whelps are the smallest and youngest dragons. Where there are whelps, their larger kin are usually close by, guarding the flight's eggs.

Dragonflight.text: A dragonflight is an organization of dragons, made up mostly of dragons of one color, along with lesser dragonkin such as drakonid and dragonspawn. Many dragonflights existed early on, but only five ended up holding dominion over the rest, chosen by the Keepers to look after the world.

Dragonhawk.text: Dragonhawks are flying creatures native to the forests of Quel'Thalas.

Dragonkin.text: Dragonkin are dragons and all the creatures descended from them. Nearly all of them belong to one of the dragonflights.

Dragonmaw clan.text: The Dragonmaw clan is an orcish clan dating back to ancient Draenor. Under the shaman Zuluhed the Whacked, they swore fealty to Warchief Blackhand and joined the Old Horde's invasion of Azeroth in the First War. After Blackhand's death, they stayed loyal by pledging to his two sons and the Black Tooth Grin clan.

Dragonmaw Grunt.text: Dragonmaw Grunts are orcs found in Dun Algaz in the Wetlands.

Dragonmaw Shadowwarder.text: Dragonmaw Shadowwarders are Dragonmaw orcs found in the Wetlands.

Dragonspawn.text: Dragonspawn are dragonkin that the dragons made to serve them. They make up the ground armies of the dragonflights.

Drake.text: Drakes are young dragons, weaker than their parents but still dangerous. A drake is about the size of a horse, with a wider wingspan. Drakes are common in the Burning Steppes, the Swamp of Sorrows and Winterspring.

Drakeadon.text: Drakeadons are four-legged, two-headed draconic beasts. Chromaggus, found in Blackwing Lair, is one of them. They were apparently made by the same experiments that created the chromatic dragonflight.

Drakonid.text: Drakonid are a bipedal, humanoid, dragon-like race created to serve their dragon masters loyally. They're typically used as guards and frontline soldiers within the five great dragonflights.

Dreadcoil (Wailing Caverns).text: Dreadcoil is a snake located in the Wailing Caverns.

Dreadscorn.text: Dreadscorn is a rare orc found at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. He patrols up and down the hill below the altar.

Dreadsteed.text: The dreadsteed of Xoroth is the epic mount for warlocks. Xoroth is the home planet of these fiery, horse-like demons, who serve as the mounts of the Dreadlords.

Dreaming Whelp.text: Dreaming Whelps are green dragon whelps found in the area of Itharius's Cave in the Swamp of Sorrows. They can be skinned for Green Whelp Scales, used in Leatherworking and Enchanting.

Dreamroarer.text: Dreamroarer is part of Ysera's green dragonflight and made his way into the mortal realm when the Nightmare corrupted the Emerald Dream. He and his broodmate Lethlas guard the gateway to the Emerald Dream at the Dream Bough in Feralas.

Dreamscythe.text: Dreamscythe is a young green drake mini-boss found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He appears in the central chamber when Jammal'an the Prophet is defeated. He is one of four young drakes under Eranikus's command, alongside Weaver, Hazzas and Morphaz.

Dreka'Sur.text: Dreka'Sur is an orc quest giver at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

Druids of the Fang.text: The Druids of the Fang are a group of corrupted druids in the Wailing Caverns. They were once part of a noble druid order led by Archdruid Naralex, who tried to use the Emerald Dream's power to restore the Barrens. Once connected to the Dream, their vision turned into a nightmare instead, and began corrupting the Caverns and the creatures in it.

Drungeld Glowerglare.text: Drungeld Glowerglare is first seen when Forba Slabchisel orders him killed for raiding her camp. After an adventurer brings back his beard, he is believed to be gone for good.

Dryad.text: Dryads are the daughters of the demigod Cenarius. They look like night elves above the waist and woodland fawns below it.

Drysnap Crawler.text: Drysnap Crawlers can be found near the coastline of Desolace.

Drysnap Pincer.text: Drysnap Pincers can be found near the coastline of Desolace.

Duggan Wildhammer.text: Duggan Wildhammer is a rare Wildhammer dwarf found in the Eastern Plaguelands. He made mead from a crate of barley that turned out to be plagued.

Duke Ragereaver.text: Duke Ragereaver is a rare undead death knight that patrols the bridge of Stratholme in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Dun Garok Spirit.text: Dun Garok Spirits are the ghosts of the Riflemen, Priests, Mountaineers and Soldiers who died defending Dun Garok. Captain Ironhill, their former commander, wants to put them to rest.

Dunemaul clan.text: The Dunemaul clan is a large clan of nomadic ogres who took over an area of Tanaris and built a compound in the south. Their leader is Gor'marok the Ravager. They eat bits of the Centipaar silithid.

Dunemaul Enforcer.text: Dunemaul Enforcers are ogres found at the Dunemaul Compound in Tanaris.

Dunemaul Ogre.text: Dunemaul Ogres can be found in Tanaris.

Durrin Direshovel.text: Durrin Direshovel is a Dark Iron dwarf found at Terror Run in Un'Goro Crater.

Dwarf.text: Dwarves are an ancient race descended from the earthen, split into several clans. Dwarves of the Ironforge clan hold the mountainous Khaz Modan region in the Eastern Kingdoms.

Dying Kodo.text: The Dying Kodo doesn't have long to live. If it isn't already at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace, it's heading there.

Earth elemental.text: Earth elementals are creatures made of rock.

Earthborer.text: Earthborers are elite worms found in the early part of Ragefire Chasm.

Earthcaller Halmgar.text: Earthcaller Halmgar is a rare quilboar found in Razorfen Kraul, past the first wooden bridge after Overlord Ramtusk.

Earthen.text: The earthen are stony, titan-forged beings created by the keepers to help shape the underground regions of the world. Most of them fell to the curse of flesh and became the mortal dwarves.

Earthgrab Totem (mob).text: Earthgrab Totems are totems summoned by various mobs throughout the world.

Echo of a Lost Soul.text: The Echo of a Lost Soul is a wraith found in graveyards near Gadgetzan in Tanaris, Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows, Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands, and the Ruins of Aboraz in Stranglethorn Vale. It's immune to most damage, and only arcane damage or repeated Holy spells can kill it.

Effritus.text: Effritus is a rare gargoyle sometimes spotted near the road to Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. It has grey and white skin.

El Pollo Grande.text: El Pollo Grande, the Black Chicken of Death, is a huge black chicken accidentally summoned by Niby the Almighty in Felwood. Niby meant to summon an infernal destroyer with Kroshius' Infernal Core, but got a giant chicken instead.

Elder Snapjaw Crocolisk.text: Elder Snapjaw Crocolisks are crocolisks found in Stranglethorn Vale.

Elemental.text: Elementals are elemental spirits that have taken on physical form. On Azeroth, the Keepers have bound them to the Elemental Plane, and the most powerful ones are called Elemental Lords.

Elite Circle.text: The Elite Circle was a group of elite Highborne guards. They attacked Dath'Remar Sunstrider while he was rescuing Tyrande Whisperwind.

Eliza.text: Eliza is an undead rare mob found in Duskwood. She wears a white dress and holds a bouquet of red roses.

Emberstrife.text: Emberstrife is an ancient black drake in Emberstrife's Den in the Wyrmbog, Dustwallow Marsh. He tests dragonspawn who want to become elite guards for Onyxia, and only the strongest pass.

Emeriss (Classic).text: Emeriss is one of the four Dragons of Nightmare.

Emissary Roman'khan.text: Emissary Roman'khan is an outdoor mob in Silithus, spawned by a quest. He drops nothing but the item the quest needs.

Empyrean.text: Empyrean is the hippogryph of Isalien. When you fight Isalien, she summons Empyrean to help her.

Enervated Adder.text: Enervated Adders are snakes located in the Barrens.

Enraged Stanley.text: Enraged Stanley is a wolf found in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He's what happens when you give the Elixir of Pain to Farmer Ray's pet Stanley, during the quest Elixir of Pain. He gives a lot more experience than normal when killed.

Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream.text: Eranikus, Tyrant of the Dream is a green dragon found in Nighthaven in Moonglade during The Nightmare Manifests, part of the quest chain for the Scepter of the Shifting Sands. Tyrande Whisperwind redeems the cursed dragon as Eranikus the Redeemed, and he returns to the Emerald Dream.

Eris Havenfire.text: Eris Havenfire is a human priest ghost found along the mountains between Terrordale and Stratholme in the Eastern Plaguelands. She gives the priest quest The Balance of Light and Shadow, which leads to the epic staff [Benediction]. Benediction can be turned into [Anathema] at will.

Ettin.text: Ettins are two-headed giants found in highland areas of the Eastern Kingdoms.

Explorers' League.text: The Explorers' League, also called the Explorers' Guild, researches the origin of the dwarven race. It has archaeological dig sites across Azeroth. Its main base is the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge.

Farmer Ray.text: Farmer Ray was a level 23 human found near Hillsbrad Fields in the Hillsbrad Foothills, on the second floor inside a house. He was a cousin to Phin Odelic. His dog Stanley was poisoned by Apothecary Lydon as a test and turned into Enraged Stanley, forcing Ray to put him down.

Farraki tribe.text: The Farraki tribe, also called the Sandfury tribe, is a tribe of sand trolls in the deserts of southern Kalimdor.

Faulty War Golem.text: The Faulty War Golem is a rare stone golem found at Grimesilt Dig Site in the Searing Gorge.

Fel orc.text: Fel orcs (also called chaos orcs or blood orcs) are orcs corrupted by drinking pit lord blood, which drives them into madness and bloodlust. They have red skin, glowing red eyes, longer tusks, and spiky growths on their body. They first appeared as Grommash Hellscream's corrupted forces during the Third War.

Fel spider.text: Fel spiders are spiders corrupted by fel magic.

Felhound.text: Felhounds are ugly, red, spined demons from the Twisting Nether. Pit lords use them to sniff out magic. They feed on it, draining wizards through two tendrils before tearing them apart.

Felhound Tracker.text: A Felhound Tracker is summoned by players using a [Fel Orb]. They track down Azsharite for the quest Azsharite.

Felwood Furbolgs.text: The Felwood Furbolgs were a tribe of furbolgs who lived in Ashenvale during the Third War. When the Orcish Horde and the Human Expedition moved into the forest, their elder shaman led the tribe deeper into the woods to avoid corruption. Tyrande Whisperwind helped gather the scattered tribe.

Fenros.text: Fenros is a rare worgen found wandering between the camps in Brightwood Grove in Duskwood, on a 5-8 hour respawn timer. He wears clothes like a lumberjack's and carries an axe, which suggests he was one before he became a worgen.

Feronas Sindweller.text: Feronas Sindweller is a night elf quest giver found at Sindweller's Rise in Felwood. He can be seen killing satyrs disguised as druids. His quests retell Illidan Stormrage's history, from his first fight with Arthas in Felwood to the day he killed Tichondrius after eating the Skull of Gul'dan.

Fire elemental.text: Fire elementals are creatures made of fire and magma.

Firebrand Legion.text: The Firebrand Legion is a division of Rend Blackhand's Blackrock orcs that live mainly in the lower levels of Blackrock Spire. Most of them are spellcasters who use fire magic. Their Firebrand Darkweavers and Dreadweavers can curse enemies with the Curse of the Firebrand, a fire curse.

Firelord (mob).text: Firelords are fire elementals found in Molten Core.

Fish.text: Fish is the edible flesh of a fish or another water animal, not always a fish in the biological sense. It's one of the game's food types, and most fish items stack in twenties.

Flame Imp.text: Flame Imps can be found in large packs in Molten Core. They respawn quickly after being killed.

Flamewaker.text: Flamewakers (sometimes called salamanders or fire salamanders) are an elemental race of serpentine creatures that serve the Firelord. They're ferocious, and among the most feared elemental guardians. Few of their fiery harbingers remain after Ragnaros's defeat.

Flesh Eater.text: Flesh Eaters are ghouls found at Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood.

Foothill Stalker.text: Foothill Stalkers are mountain lions found in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Forest Creeper.text: Forest Creepers are tarantulas found all over the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Forest Strider.text: Forest Strider is a tallstrider found at the Darkmoon Faire.

Foulmane.text: Foulmane is a rare ghoul in the Western Plaguelands, at the farm known as Dalson's Tears.

Foulweald tribe.text: Foulwealds are a tribe of hostile, corrupted furbolgs in Ashenvale. Karang Amakkar at Zoram'Gar Outpost sees them as a threat to the Horde. Their home is Greenpaw Village.

Four Horsemen (Classic).text: The Four Horsemen are Highlord Alexandros Mograine, Thane Korth'azz, Lady Blaumeux and Sir Zeliek, four death knights in the service of Kel'Thuzad. They are the third and final encounter of the Deathknight wing of Naxxramas.

Frenzied Spirit.text: Frenzied Spirits are elite wraiths found at the far end of the Forlorn Cloister in the Scarlet Monastery, near Thalnos the Soulrender.

Frenzy.text: Frenzies are large, piranha-like fish found throughout Azeroth. They're usually hostile aquatic beasts, though the Loch Frenzy can also be caught by fishing.

Frostmane tribe.text: The Frostmane tribe is a tribe of ice trolls that live in Dun Morogh, fighting a guerrilla war against the dwarves of Ironforge. They let the troggs and dwarves fight each other while they wait for a chance to take back their land. They're found around Dun Morogh, including Shimmer Ridge, Frostmane Retreat and Frostmane Hovel.

Frostmane Troll Whelp.text: Frostmane Troll Whelps are ice trolls found at the southwestern end of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

Frostwave Lieutenant.text: The Frostwave Lieutenant is a water elemental summoned by touching an Ice Stone in Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. As a water elemental, it is immune to spells in the frost school.

Frostwolf clan.text: The Frostwolf Clan, also called the Frost Wolf clan or simply the Frostwolves, wants to drive the dwarves of the Stormpike Expedition out of Alterac Valley. They value family and community, and try to live in harmony with the land.

Frostwolf Envoy.text: Frostwolf Envoys were orc Alterac Valley recruiters found in Orgrimmar.

Furbolg.text: Furbolgs are a hulking, simple-minded race of bear-men who live in the northern regions of Kalimdor. Many of their tribes have fallen to corruption and turned hostile, but some, such as the Timbermaw, tolerate outsiders. The furbolgs were old allies of the night elves.

Fyldren Moonfeather.text: Fyldren Moonfeather was a night elf hippogryph flight master located in Feathermoon Stronghold of Feralas.

Gadgetzan Water Company.text: The Gadgetzan Water Company (or Gadgetzan Water Co.) is a subgroup of the Gadgetzan goblins that builds wells across the desert for fresh water. Its members are found in Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port. The Water Co. Security is their security service.

Galak Mauler.text: Galak Maulers are centaur located in Thousand Needles.

Galak Stormer.text: Galak Stormers are centaur located in Thousand Needles.

Galak tribe.text: The Galak centaur live in Thousand Needles. Their founding khan was Khan Veng, one of the offspring of Zaetar and Princess Theradras. They currently have no khan.

Galak Wrangler.text: Galak Wranglers are centaur found in Thousand Needles.

Galen Goodward.text: Galen Goodward is a human quest giver located in a cage in Fallow Sanctuary in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Gan'rul Bloodeye.text: Gan'rul Bloodeye was an orc located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

Gargoyle.text: Gargoyles are large, vicious, bat-like creatures that can turn to stone for a time. Most of them serve the Scourge.

Gazz'uz.text: Gazz'uz is an orc warlock hiding in the cave system of Skull Rock, a Burning Blade hideout, in Durotar. He is a member of the Burning Blade coven and his small rebellion on the outskirts of Orgrimmar poses a threat to Neeru Fireblade as told by the mysterious voice inside his Eye of Burning Shadow.

Gelkis clan.text: The Gelkis clan are centaurs who live in the southern part of Desolace. They are enemies of the Magram clan, a rival centaur tribe also in southern Desolace. Their founding khan was Gelk, one of the offspring of Zaetar and Theradras.

Gelkis Rumbler.text: Gelkis Rumblers are earth elementals summoned by Gelkis Earthcallers at Gelkis Village in southern Desolace.

General Marcus Jonathan.text: General Marcus Jonathan was a human warrior and the former high commander of Stormwind Defense. He could be found as a quest giver in the Valley of Heroes of Stormwind City.

Geopriest Gukk'rok.text: Geopriest Gukk'rok is a rare quilboar found guarding a Bristleback den in the Barrens. Gukk'rok is on a 2-3 hour respawn timer.

Ghost.text: Ghosts are tortured spirits, trapped between the realms of the living and the dead. They often don't know that they are no longer alive. Their hunger for touch does great harm to any living thing they reach.

Ghoul.text: Ghouls are rotting corpses that serve as the Scourge's shock troops. They were once innocent townsfolk, and they devour the flesh of the fallen. Ghouls terrorize the Plaguelands, and mindless ones are found in Silverpine Forest and Duskwood.

Giant.text: Giants are like humanoids, but very large, bigger than most ogres. The type covers most large humanoids that are semi-intelligent, and some that are intelligent. Most giants are elite.

Gikkix.text: Gikkix is a goblin fish and drink vendor located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

Gilnid.text: Gilnid <The Smelter> is a goblin found in the Deadmines. He is the head smelter for Edwin VanCleef.

Ginro Hearthkindle.text: Ginro Hearthkindle is a night elf quest giver located in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. Quintis Jonespyre had contracted a debt of Kalimdor Hold 'Em to Ginro.

Giraffe.text: Giraffes are long-necked animals found in the Barrens, in central Kalimdor. Centaur overhunted them for decades, but the tauren saved them from extinction.

Glomp.text: Glomp is an ogre located on Fray Island in the Barrens. He is the Treasurer of the Southsea Freebooters.

Gnarlpine tribe.text: The Gnarlpine tribe is a corrupted furbolg tribe that lives on Teldrassil. Fel Moss drove them to attack the night elves, who were once their allies. They live in Gnarlpine Hold and other villages across southern and western Teldrassil, and have taken over Ban'ethil Barrow Den and Starbreeze Village.

Gnome.text: Gnomes are a race of small, highly intelligent humanoids known for their mastery of technology. They settled in Khaz Modan, founded Gnomeregan, and allied with the dwarves. A trogg invasion and a betrayal from within irradiated Gnomeregan and killed about eighty percent of the gnomish population.

Gnomeregan Army.text: The Gnomeregan Army is the main military force of the gnomish kingdom of Gnomeregan. It supplied the Alliance with advanced weapons and war machines during the Second War. After Gnomeregan fell and the gnomes lost eighty percent of their population, it took years to rebuild while they lived in exile in Ironforge.

Gnomeregan Evacuee.text: Gnomeregan Evacuees are gnomes who fled from Gnomeregan.

Goblin.text: Goblins are small green humanoids from the Isle of Kezan. Their love of money, explosives and technology makes them dangerous to their enemies and to themselves. Trade princes rule the goblin cartels, and most goblins stay neutral and sell their goods and services to other races.

Golden Circle.text: The Golden Circle is an organization of goblin trade princes. They hire fighters who stand out in the Venture Company's gladiator tournaments in Ratchet, as bodyguards or caravan escorts.

Golem.text: Golems are constructs made by magic from bone, flesh, metal or stone, and are thought to be mindless. They are usually built to guard a person, a place or a thing.

Golemagg the Incinerator.text: Golemagg the Incinerator is a molten giant in the service of Ragnaros. He keeps two core ragers, offspring of Magmadar, as tamed pets, which has earned him Magmadar's anger.

Gor'tesh.text: Gor'tesh, the brute lord, is an ogre and the leader of the Firegut ogres in the Burning Steppes. He hides among the Blackrock clan forces near the Pillar of Ash instead of ruling from Dreadmaul Rock. Oralius wanted Gor'tesh's head for a party.

Gorick Guzzledraught.text: Gorick Guzzledraught is a Dark Iron dwarf spy who hides in a cave in Grizzlepaw Ridge in Loch Modan. He stole a document from the Explorers' League in Thelsamar and fled to his hideout, where he keeps it by his campfire. Courier Morick Darkbrew is sometimes nearby.

Grand Inquisitor Isillien.text: Grand Inquisitor Isillien is a human priest, the spiritual heart of the Scarlet Crusade in the Western Plaguelands.

Grand Magus Doane.text: Grand Magus Doane is found in the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains.

Gravelflint Scout.text: Gravelflint Scouts are troggs located at Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore.

Graw Cornerstone.text: Graw Cornerstone is a dwarf armor vendor in a small camp northeast of the Blackrock Mountain entrance in the Searing Gorge.

Green dragonflight.text: The green dragonflight is led by the green dragons, whose creed is to preserve nature. The titan Eonar charged Ysera and her flight with protecting the natural world and the Emerald Dream. Green dragons are generally approachable, and often work with druids and the Cenarion Circle.

Greymist tribe.text: The Greymist tribe is a tribe of murlocs that live around Mist's Edge in Darkshore. They may be led by Murkdeep, who the Auberdine Village Council wants for killing a Sentinel and sinking cargo ships.

Grimfrost clan.text: The Grimfrost clan is a small clan of ogres, led by Guttra Wolfchew, that lives in Grimfrost Hill. They've skirmished with outriders of the Frostwolf clan, and hate the Frostwolf clan's wolves.

Grimtotem tribe.text: The Grimtotem tribe is one of the most powerful tauren tribes. Unlike most tauren, they are aggressive, and want to drive out other races and take back old tauren land. To the Grimtotem, almost every other race is an enemy of the tauren.

Grok (animal).text: A grok is a kind of livestock that orcs would take to slaughter. When the first orcs came through the portal to Azeroth, they killed the people of a small human village. Garona Halforcen compared the killing of the women and children there to taking grok to slaughter.

Grol'dar.text: Grol'dar is an orc warlock trainer located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

Ground squirrel.text: Ground squirrels in the game are prairie dogs, marmots or gophers. They're closely related to regular squirrels, but count as their own group. Lemmings share the same model, even though they're more closely related to rats and mice.

Grouper.text: A grouper is a medium-sized fish. It's caught by fishing.

Groyat, the Blind Hunter.text: Groyat, the Blind Hunter, is a giant albino bat in Razorfen Kraul. It's thought to be blind, and it uses sonic pulses to find trespassers and prey.

Gryphon.text: Gryphons (also called griffons or griffins) are powerful, intelligent winged beasts, with the forequarters of an eagle and the hindquarters of a lion. They're native to Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands, and have long been bonded with the Wildhammer dwarves, who introduced them to the rest of the Alliance.

Gryphon rider.text: Gryphon riders are aerial troops who fly for the Alliance. Most are Wildhammer dwarves, who fight with stormhammers and share a bond with their gryphon mounts. A group of gryphon riders is called a gryphon wing.

Guardian of Elune.text: The Guardian of Elune could be found behind the Altar of Elune in Winterspring, during the quest Guardians of the Altar. A Priestess of Elune describes it as a creature with the feathers of an owl and the will and might of a bear.

Guardian of Icecrown.text: Guardians of Icecrown are crypt lords summoned during phase 3 of the Kel'Thuzad encounter in Naxxramas. When Kel'Thuzad shouts for aid, two Guardians come through the portals in his chamber.

Guardian of the Deep.text: The Guardian of the Deep is an elite deepsea crab boss found in the Forgotten Pool in Blackfathom Deeps. It chased out Old Serra'kis to make a new lair for its brood.

Gubber Blump.text: Gubber Blump is a dwarf fishing trainer in Auberdine, Darkshore. He stands on the beach, between the flight master and the dock.

Gurubashi Blood Drinker.text: Gurubashi Blood Drinkers are jungle trolls found in Zul'Gurub. They use blood magic.

Gurubashi Refugee.text: Gurubashi Refugees are trolls in the northeastern part of Zul'Gurub, near the Cache of Madness and the gates of the Temple of Bethekk. They sit or lie down around the area.

Gurubashi Soul-Seeker.text: Gurubashi Soul-Seekers are jungle trolls found in Stranglethorn Vale.

Gurubashi Worker.text: Gurubashi Workers are trolls found in Zul'Gurub.

Halycon.text: Halycon is a giant red and black worg owned by the Bloodaxe Legion. She and her mate Gizrul the Slavener produce the orcs' attack worgs. She is kept with her pups in Halycon's Nest, deep in Blackrock Spire, guarded by orcs and worgs.

Harb Foulmountain.text: Harb Foulmountain is a rare tauren found patrolling across three small plateaus in the northern part of Darkcloud Pinnacle in Thousand Needles.

Harpy.text: Harpies are vicious flying creatures that look like a cross between a night elf and a bird of prey, with talons for feet and wings for arms. They have little in common with elves despite the resemblance. Harpies use nature magic like night elves do, but they destroy the land they settle in and kill every creature they find.

Haunted Servitor.text: Haunted Servitors are elite human ghosts found in Shadowfang Keep.

Hawk.text: Hawks are raptorial birds found throughout Azeroth. Ospreys are a type of sea hawk.

Hazzas.text: Hazzas is a young green drake found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He is one of Eranikus's dragons, and he appears in the central chamber after Jammal'an the Prophet is defeated.

Healing Ward IV.text: Healing Ward IV is a healing ward summoned by Thistlefur Totemics in Ashenvale.

Hearthsinger Forresten.text: Hearthsinger Forresten is an elite rare ghost in Stratholme, between the Main Gate and the Service Entrance. He is the ghost of a traveling musician, and he drops [Piccolo of the Flaming Fire], which makes nearby allies dance.

Heigan the Unclean.text: Heigan the Unclean is the second boss of the Plague Quarter in Naxxramas. Players call him the dance boss.

Henry Stern.text: Henry Stern is a human found in the Murder Pens of Razorfen Downs. He is an alchemist and cooking trainer who teaches the recipes for Major Troll's Blood Potion and [Goldthorn Tea].

Hetaera.text: Hetaera is a hydra in Azshara. Her lair is Hetaera's Clutch, and she is often seen swimming north of it or resting on two small islands nearby. She has killed many of Lord Arkkoroc's children and calls herself the ruler of these oceans.

Hidden Circle.text: The Hidden Circle is an Alliance rogue organization based in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. It's led by Hulfdan Blackbeard. King Magni Bronzebeard once had agents investigate and arrest several of its members.

High Chief Winterfall.text: High Chief Winterfall is a furbolg found in Timbermaw Post in Winterspring. Donova Snowden sends adventurers to kill him and bring back his [Crudely-Written Log]. Killing him awards 40 reputation with Timbermaw Hold.

High elf.text: High elves, or quel'dorei, are a race descended from the night elf Highborne. Millennia after the Great Sundering, they settled in the Eastern Kingdoms and founded the kingdom of Quel'Thalas, ruled by the Sunstrider dynasty. Their society was built around the Sunwell, a magical fount of arcane energy in the forests north of Lordaeron.

High Inquisitor Fairbanks.text: High Inquisitor Fairbanks is an undead found in a secret chamber in the Cathedral of Scarlet Monastery. He was once a priest and a member of the Knights of the Silver Hand, and later the Scarlet Crusade's High Inquisitor. The crusaders executed him for speaking out against Saidan Dathrohan and Renault Mograine, and he rose again as undead.

Hippogryph rider.text: Hippogryph riders are aerial troops who ride hippogryphs. Most are female night elf archers and scouts of the Sentinel Army.

Hive'Ashi Worker.text: Hive'Ashi Workers are silithid scarabs that live in Hive'Ashi in Silithus. They are neutral and won't attack unless attacked first or you're fighting near their patrol. They are uncommon, with long patrol routes around the hive.

Hive'Regal Burrower.text: Hive'Regal Burrowers are silithid scarabs that live in Hive'Regal in Silithus. They are neutral and won't attack unless attacked first or you're fighting near their patrol. They spawn in fewer places than other Hive'Regal bugs, but respawn faster.

Hive'Zara Sandstalker.text: Hive'Zara Sandstalkers are elite silithid reavers found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

Hive'Zora Reaver.text: Hive'Zora Reavers are silithid reavers found in Hive'Zora in Silithus. They are common, and easily found around the perimeter of the hive.

Hive'Zora Tunneler.text: Hive'Zora Tunnelers are silithid scarabs that live in Hive'Zora in Silithus. They are neutral and won't attack unless attacked first or you're fighting near their patrol. They are uncommon, with long patrol routes around the hive.

Hobgoblin.text: Hobgoblins (also called brutes, oafs, or mooks) are large, mutated goblins usually found guarding goblin settlements, as bodyguards or as mounts. They were once regular goblins, changed by alchemy to be tough and powerful, though not very smart. Despite that, some hobgoblins are as sharp as anyone, while others act more like ogres.

Horde.text: The Horde is one of the two major factions of Azeroth, and has traditionally been at war with the Alliance. It's a coalition of different races and cultures, led originally by orcs who came from another world.

Houndmaster Grebmar.text: Houndmaster Grebmar Fleabeard is an elite dwarf mini-boss in Blackrock Depths. He resides under the arena with his pack of pet dogs. He drops the [Spritecaster Cape].

Human.text: Humans are a species native to Azeroth. They're one of the younger races on the world, and they've faced many hardships.

Humanoid.text: A humanoid usually has two arms, two legs and a head, or a human-like torso and a head.

Humar the Pridelord.text: Humar the Pridelord is a rare lion found just outside Ratchet in the Barrens. When low on health, he roars and aggroes all the nearby lions.

Hurley Blackbreath.text: Hurley Blackbreath is an elite Dark Iron dwarf hiding in the Grim Guzzler bar inside Blackrock Depths. Both Ragnar Thunderbrew and Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave want the ale recipe he stole. To get his attention, you have to destroy his large kegs of brew.

Hydra.text: Hydras are three-headed amphibious beasts native to Azeroth. They've existed since ancient times.

Hydromancer Velratha.text: Hydromancer Velratha is an elite sand troll found in Zul'Farrak. She stole the [Tiara of the Deep] from Tabetha and possesses the [Second Mosh'aru Tablet].

Ice troll.text: Ice trolls, also known as frost trolls, are trolls that live in frigid lands they've adapted to.

Imp.text: Imps are small, cackling, mischievous demons of felfire and trickery. Alone they are little threat, but in a group they can overwhelm an enemy. The imp is the first demon a warlock learns to summon.

Imperial Qiraji Destroyer.text: Imperial Qiraji Destroyers are qiraji gladiators found in Silithus, summoned by Resonating Crystal Formations during the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.

Incendosaur.text: Incendosaurs are diemetradons found in Searing Gorge, large crimson reptiles that once lived deep in the Slag Pit. They now roam the rocky ground around Iron Summit.

Infected Deer.text: Infected Deer are ordinary deer that have become infected with the Plague of Undeath in the Eastern Plaguelands and Silverpine Forest.

Infernal.text: Infernals are nearly mindless masses of matter and fel energy, made by more powerful demons. They fall to earth as green, molten meteorites. They exist only to destroy every living thing in their path.

Infested Bear.text: Infested Bears are gray plagued bears found in southwestern Hillsbrad Foothills. They have been infested with spider eggs.

Instructor Galford.text: Instructor Galford is a mini-boss in Stratholme. He used to be Archivist Galford, a mortal human skilled in fire magic. When Balnazzar slew the Scarlet Crusade's Crimson Legion in Stratholme and raised them as the Risen, Galford was transformed too.

Instructor Razuvious.text: Instructor Razuvious is the first boss in the Military Quarter of Naxxramas. The most feared of the Scourge's death knight trainers, he's accompanied by two Death Knight Understudies, which the raid can use to defeat him.

Ironforge Firebreather.text: Ironforge Firebreathers are dwarves and gnomes found in Ironforge.

Ironhide Devilsaur.text: Ironhide Devilsaurs patrol Un'Goro Crater. Players sometimes call them "Ninjasaurs" because they have a habit of sneaking up from behind. Killing one drops [Devilsaur Leather], used in some crafting recipes.

Isalien.text: Isalien is a priest spirit summoned in the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul, as part of the Dungeon 2 quest line, after killing Alzzin the Wildshaper. She was once a member of the mercenary company Veiled Blade.

Jade (drake).text: Jade is a rare green drake in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Jadefire Felsworn.text: Jadefire Felsworns can be found in Felwood.

Jailor Marlgen.text: Jailor Marlgen was a level 24 human found in Durnholde Keep in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He carried the key needed to free Tog'thar. He was a member of the Syndicate, but killing him didn't change your Syndicate or Ravenholdt reputation.

Jazzrik.text: Jazzrik is a goblin blacksmithing vendor located in a small camp in the Valley of Fangs in Badlands.

Jed Runewatcher.text: Jed Runewatcher is a rare spawn orc in Upper Blackrock Spire. He may wander in the room of Goraluk Anvilcrack or in the Furnace, near The Beast.

Jewel.text: Jewel is a nightsaber located at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Jeziba.text: Jeziba is a high elf quest giver located in the Ruins of Andorhal inn in the Western Plaguelands.

Jory Zaga.text: Jory Zaga was a level 58 female jungle troll of the Shatterspear tribe found in Shatterspear Village.

Jugkar Grim'rod.text: Jugkar Grim'rod is an orc warlock in Desolace, an associate of the doomguard Lord Azrethoc. He represents the Burning Blade at the Mannoroc Coven.

Jungle Toad (Zul'Gurub).text: Jungle Toads are critters summoned by Hakkari Witch Doctors in Zul'Gurub.

Jungle troll.text: Jungle trolls are a troll subgroup found mainly in Stranglethorn Vale. They're also called Gurubashi, after the ancient troll empire of that name. Their capital, Zul'Gurub, is in Stranglethorn Vale, along with many smaller troll towns and villages.

Kaldorei Empire.text: The Kaldorei Empire was an ancient night elf civilization that spanned most of ancient Kalimdor, from Lathar'Lazal in the west to Uldaman in the east. Queen Azshara ruled it, and its capital city, Zin-Azshari, was named for her. Kaldorei society was class-based, with the Highborne at the top.

Keeper Albagorm.text: Keeper Albagorm is a keeper of the grove located at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. He gives quests to adventurers in the area.

Kel'Thuzad (Classic).text: Kel'Thuzad, once a sorcerer of the Kirin Tor of Dalaran, is the chief lieutenant of the Lich King. He rules the Eastern Plaguelands from his citadel of Naxxramas, where he's the final boss.

King Crawler.text: King Crawlers are crabs found in the Steam Pools in Feralas.

King Gordok.text: King Gordok is the title of the ruling Gordunni ogre king in the Gordok Commons of Dire Maul. Whoever holds the title changes as adventurers kill the current king.

King Mosh.text: King Mosh is a rare devilsaur in the northwest of Un'Goro Crater, between the river and the large lakes. He once fought Kova Broadhorn and Miles Corebender.

King's Council.text: The King's Council served King Llane Wrynn before and during the First War. Lord Anduin Lothar, the King's Champion, was part of it. Dalaran sent ambassadors to Stormwind, and the Council received them.

Knight.text: Knights are noble, horse-mounted warriors. They're usually human, or raised Forsaken, though other races have knights too, such as elves, dwarves and gnomes. Knights can also be found among the Scourge, Twilight's Hammer and the Burning Legion.

Kobold.text: Kobolds are small, rat-like humanoids that live in caves and mines across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. They aren't very intelligent, and they'd rather keep their distance from other, larger races. Kobolds wear candles on their heads to light their way through the dark tunnels they live in.

Kohor.text: Kohor is an orc warlock and the leader of the Burning Blade in Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace. He can be found just outside a cave with tunnels that lead under the fortress. After he sacrificed a Horde and an Alliance scout and began threatening Furien's Post and Nijel's Point, Sorrem and Captain Pentigast sent adventurers to kill him.

Kolkar clan.text: The Kolkar clan is one of five centaur clans native to Desolace, with settlements in the Barrens and Desolace. Their founding leader was Kolk, said to be a son of Zaetar and Theradras and the first of the centaur khans.

Kolkar Wrangler.text: Kolkar Wranglers are centaurs found in the Barrens.

Kormok.text: Kormok is an ogre necromancer boss found in Scholomance. He has two heads: one cheerful and foolish, the other sly and calculating. He was once a mage in the Veiled Blade before he turned to necromancy, and now summons the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle.

Korrak the Bloodrager.text: Korrak the Bloodrager (also known as Korrak the Everliving) is a dire troll and the leader of the Winterax tribe of ice trolls. He formerly controlled the Field of Strife in the middle of Alterac Valley.

Krah'ranik.text: Krah'ranik was a jungle troll of the Shatterspear tribe, located at Shatterspear Village. His fate after the night elf assault on the village is unknown.

Krastinovian Carver.text: Krastinovian Carvers are humans and undead that appear after the Chamber of Summoning in Scholomance. They are students of the rare Theolen Krastinov, surgically altered to look like him.

Krenka tribe.text: The Krenka tribe is a small centaur clan in the Barrens. They believe every animal in the Barrens has a guiding spirit that controls what it does and its fate. Honoring a guiding spirit can earn the tribe its blessing.

Kurgul.text: Kurgul is an orc warlock in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

Kurinnaxx.text: Kurinnaxx is a large sand reaver and the first boss in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. He has a wide aggro radius and can see stealthed rogues. The Horde, led by Varok Saurfang, faced Kurinnaxx when they raided the ruins.

Kurzen Jungle Fighter.text: Kurzen Jungle Fighters can be found in Stranglethorn Vale.

Kurzen Mindslave.text: Kurzen Mindslaves are humans found in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe in Stranglethorn Vale. Mogh the Undying mind-controls them, and they heal him when he's attacked.

Kurzen's Agent.text: Kurzen's Agent is sent by Kurzen's Expedition to kill Private Thorsen.

Lady Szallah.text: Lady Szallah is a rare naga found in the western Ruins of Feathermoon in Feralas.

Lake Creeper.text: Lake Creepers are bog beasts located in Silverpine Forest.

Landen Stilwell.text: Landen Stilwell was a human located in a cell to the left of Sorcerer Ashcrombe's own cell in Shadowfang Keep. He was involved in the quest The Path of the Adept.

Lapress.text: Lapress is a rare silithid found in Hive'Regal in Silithus.

Lars.text: Lars was a human quest giver at a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank in Duskwood. He spent his days trying to survive with his companion Sven Yorgen.

Lasher.text: Lashers are walking plants found in many parts of Azeroth. Orchid lashers have especially large flowers.

Lashtail Raptor.text: Lashtail Raptors are raptors found in Stranglethorn Vale.

Lathoric the Black.text: Lathoric the Black is a dwarf found deep within the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge. Lathoric is actually Dorius Stonetender, and has set up the player by faking his assassination. He betrayed his brother Curator Thorius by enslaving archaeologists sent from Ironforge and forcing them to work on the golem Obsidion.

Latronicus Moonspear.text: Latronicus Moonspear, nicknamed Latro, was a night elf quest giver in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. He was one of the community's foremost fighters against the naga. Tyrande Whisperwind later found his corpse in one of the buildings there.

Lava Annihilator.text: Lava Annihilators are lava elementals summoned by Ragnaros in Molten Core. They have no special attacks and change targets frequently.

Lava Elemental.text: Lava Elementals are found in Baron Geddon and Shazzrah's room in Molten Core. Two spawn together with a Firewalker and a Flameguard, forming a Lava Pack.

Lava Surger.text: Lava Surgers are lava elementals found in Molten Core. They surge around randomly, knocking aside anyone in their path.

League of Arathor Emissary.text: League of Arathor Emissaries were human recruiters for Arathi Basin, found in Stormwind City.

Leper gnome.text: Leper gnomes are a diseased, mutated race of gnomes that wander the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan. The radiation left their minds crazed, and they attack anyone who enters, believing them to be trogg invaders. Some devolve further, until they become mindless puddles of toxic sludge.

Leprithus.text: Leprithus is a rare ghoul found in Westfall, flanked by two Rotten Ghouls. It spawns in several places, including under a tree southwest of the Jangolode Mine.

Lesser Silithid Flayer.text: Lesser Silithid Flayers are silithid found in Thousand Needles. They were one of the mobs spawned during the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.

Lesser Water Elemental.text: Lesser Water Elementals are water elementals found around the haunted isle in Stranglethorn Vale. A wizard named Gazban summoned them all. The [Stone of the Tides] could be used to control them.

Lethlas.text: Lethlas is part of Ysera's green dragonflight. He and his broodmate, Dreamroarer, guard the gateway to the Dream at the Dream Bough in Feralas.

Lethon (Classic).text: Lethon is one of the four Dragons of Nightmare.

Lich.text: Liches are powerful undead, usually bound to the will of the Lich King. They wield frost magic and necromancy and often hold high rank in the Scourge. A lich binds its soul to a phylactery, and dies for good only when the phylactery is destroyed.

Lieutenant Hawlsey.text: Lieutenant Hawlsey is a human located at Valgan's Field in Silverpine Forest. He supervises the training of new recruits for the Scarlet Crusade for their war against the Forsaken.

Lieutenant Rugba.text: Lieutenant Rugba was a level 59 elite serving the Horde in Alterac Valley. He was situated outside Iceblood Graveyard.

Lieutenant Sanders.text: Lieutenant Sanders is a human found hanging dead upside down from a chain at the Scarlet Encampment in Tirisfal Glades.

Lieutenant Vol'talar.text: Lieutenant Vol'talar was a level 59 elite jungle troll serving the Horde in Alterac Valley.

Lillith Nefara.text: Lillith Nefara is a wraith and Scourge agent. She spawns after completing The Dormant Shade, at Lillith's Dinner Table on an islet next to Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. Gunther Arcanus wants her killed.

Lindea Rabonne.text: Lindea Rabonne was a human fishing vendor located on the docks in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Lindros.text: Lindros was a passenger on the Horizon Scout before it sank. He had business in Azshara, but what it was is unknown.

Living Poison.text: Living Poison are untargetable oozelings that cross the pathway between Patchwerk and Grobbulus in Naxxramas. Touching one causes it to explode, dealing upwards of 30,000 damage, which is enough to kill instantly. They can't be targeted, so anyone getting past them has to avoid them.

Lok Orcbane.text: Lok Orcbane is a quilboar found in Blackthorn Ridge in the Barrens. Mangletooth told Horde adventurers that Lok was the leader and sent them to kill him and bring back his skull as proof.

Lord Cyrik Blackforge.text: Lord Cyrik Blackforge is a dwarf found in Bael Modan in the Barrens. He was standing near a flying machine and was likely its pilot.

Lord Kazzak (tactics).text: Lord Kazzak was originally found in Tainted Scar in Blasted Lands.
