Lord Lakmaeran.text: Lord Lakmaeran was a named chimaera located on the Isle of Dread in Feralas. He required 7 to 10 people to kill. He had no significant loot table, but was required for the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest line.

Lord Maldazzar.text: Lord Maldazzar is a rare human found in the Western Plaguelands.

Lord Raymond George.text: Lord Raymond George was once the leader of the Argent Dawn. It is unknown exactly how he died, but he returned in his ghostly form to help train new recruits by battling them. He provides the only repeatable reputation quests for the Classic Argent Dawn faction, in Scholomance and at the Stratholme Main Gate.

Lord Sinslayer.text: Lord Sinslayer is a rare naga found in Darkshore.

Lordaeron army.text: The Lordaeron army was the main military force of the human kingdom of Lordaeron. It was the first to answer Anduin Lothar's call to arms, and it fought the Horde through the Second War. Arthas Menethil and his undead servants destroyed the army during the Scourging of Lordaeron.

Lordain's tribe.text: The tribe led by Lordain was the strongest of the human tribes that lived in Tirisfal Glades before the Troll Wars. They were more regimented and knightly than the mountain-dwelling Alteraci, and deeply religious. They held rituals at shrines and sacred groves throughout Tirisfal.

Loremaster Dibbs.text: Loremaster Dibbs was a human quest giver located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He didn't seem impressed at what the Crushridge ogres may have done to the various books and tomes still located within the Ruins of Alterac.

Lost One.text: The Lost Ones are badly mutated. Many of them have become savage and primitive.

Maexxna Spiderling.text: Maexxna Spiderlings are spiders that spawn during the fight with Maexxna.

Magical beast.text: Magical beasts are like animals, but can be more intelligent. Many have supernatural or extraordinary abilities, though some are simply strange in appearance or habits.

Magistrate Burnside.text: Magistrate Rutherford Burnside is a human, the magistrate of Hillsbrad in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Magma snail.text: Magma snails, also called lava snails, are snail-like fire elementals found in volcanic areas. They're similar to magma slugs, and made entirely of elemental lava. In combat, they throw lava at their enemies, and their molten slime slows and burns anyone it touches.

Magmadar.text: Magmadar is a boss in Molten Core, a beast of rock and magma that spawned the core hounds found there. The flamewaker Lucifron protects it, along with packs of hounds.

Magmus.text: Magmus is a fiery molten giant, a mini-boss in the Iron Hall in Blackrock Depths. He guards the Emperor's Seat, and triggers statues in the hall to spew fire when pulled into battle.

Magram clan.text: The Magram clan is one of five centaur clans of Kalimdor, settled in southeastern Desolace. Their founding leader was Khan Magra, an alleged son of Zaetar and Theradras. The Magram are old enemies of the Gelkis clan, and they'll work with adventurers who act against the Gelkis.

Mahamba.text: Mahamba, the Water Spirit, is an enormous crocolisk rare mob on the east shore of Lake Nazferiti, on the northern edge of the Venture Co. Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. It's one of three totemic spirits worshipped by the Bloodscalp tribe.

Mana Sprite.text: Mana Sprites are wisps found roaming throughout Deadwind Pass.

Manathirst Imp.text: Manathirst Imps are imps located in Mazthoril in Winterspring.

Mangeclaw.text: Mangeclaw is a huge Ice Claw Bear found east of the road to South Gate Pass, at the far eastern end of Dun Morogh. It stalked siege engine pilot Mori Hildelve for two and a half days before charging him from behind.

Mangletooth.text: Mangletooth is a quilboar, the new leader of the Razormane tribe in the Barrens. Before he escaped Camp Taurajo, he was a quest giver there, sending Horde adventurers to kill other quilboar.

Mannoroc Coven.text: Mannoroc Coven is in Desolace, south of Ghost Walker Post and east of Shadowprey Village. Night elf ruins stand there, and the coven is named after the pit lord Mannoroth. Demons have blasted the already-dead earth there with fel magic.

Maraudine Marauder.text: Maraudine Marauders are found in the Valley of Spears.

Maraudine Windchaser.text: Maraudine Windchasers are centaur found in the Valley of Spears in Desolace.

Maraudos.text: Maraudos is an elite undead centaur found in Maraudon. In life he was the fourth alleged offspring of Zaetar and Theradras, and the first Khan of the Maraudine clan, which is named after him. He manifests when the [Amulet of Spirits] is used on the Spirit of Maraudos.

Marosh the Devious.text: Marosh the Devious is a furbolg found in Twilight Vale in Darkshore. Sentinel Aynasha was traveling to Auberdine with an important message when he and his trackers attacked her.

Maur Grimtotem.text: Maur Grimtotem is a tauren who died in Ragefire Chasm. He was a diplomat sent by Magatha Grimtotem to make peace with the troggs, and his corpse was guarded by Oggleflint.

Mechanical.text: Mechanical is the creature type for machines and constructs made of metal or other manufactured parts.

Mechanical squirrel.text: Mechanical squirrels are small robots that look like squirrels. Engineers can craft them to serve as pets, combat devices or scouting devices.

Mirket.text: Mirket is an orc warlock trainer located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

Mo'grosh Ogre.text: Mo'grosh Ogres are ogres located in Loch Modan.

Mojo the Twisted.text: Mojo the Twisted is a rare ogre found in the Blasted Lands. He has Fel Armor, which increases his spell power and regenerates his health.

Monkey.text: Monkeys are a species of primate, and infamous tricksters. They're found primarily in Stranglethorn Vale.

Moonrage pack.text: The Moonrage pack is what people call the people of Pyrewood Village, below Shadowfang Keep. They used to be ordinary people of the kingdom of Gilneas, until the mad archmage Arugal cursed them. Now they turn into worgen at night.

Moonstalker.text: Moonstalkers are nightsabers found in Darkshore. Their striped, black-colored fur is unusual, and it draws some hunters to tame them.

Morbent Fel.text: Morbent Fel is a human necromancer who ruled the undead of Duskwood from his house atop the Forlorn Rowe in Raven Hill Cemetery. He was guarded by undead minions and a magical barrier that blocked attacks against him. He was an ally of the Dark Riders and raised the undead in Duskwood.

Morgaine the Sly.text: Morgaine the Sly is a rare human found in the house at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest. She stays loyal to the Defias Brotherhood. Her respawn timer is about 25–30 minutes.

Morphaz.text: Morphaz is a young green drake and a member of the Wardens of the Dream, found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He appears in the central chamber after Jammal'an the Prophet is defeated. He is one of four green drakes under Eranikus's command, along with Dreamscythe, Weaver and Hazzas.

Mosshide Gnoll.text: Mosshide Gnolls are part of the Mosshide tribe of gnolls found in central Wetlands.

Mosshide Representative.text: Mosshide Representative is a Mosshide gnoll located in Loch Modan. Alliance adventurers trick Bluegill Representatives into killing him.

Mosshoof Stag.text: Mosshoof Stags are stags found in southwestern Azshara.

Mottled Raptor.text: Mottled Raptors are raptors found in the Wetlands.

Mouldering Mirebeast.text: Mouldering Mirebeasts are creatures found in the Green Belt in the Wetlands. Rethiel the Greenwarden says they are bog beasts infested with rot.

Mountaineer Angst.text: Mountaineer Angst is a dwarf located at the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan.

Mountaineer Barn.text: Mountaineer Barn is a dwarf located at the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan.

Mountaineer Haggil.text: Mountaineer Haggil is a dwarf located at the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan.

Mountaineer Haggis.text: Mountaineer Haggis is a dwarf located at the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan.

Mountaineer Morlic.text: Mountaineer Morlic is a dwarf located at the Stonewrought Dam in Loch Modan.

Mugglefin.text: Mugglefin is a rare murloc found roaming about Lake Falathim in Ashenvale. It was on an 8.5-12.5 respawn timer.

Mulgris Deepriver.text: Mulgris Deepriver is a tauren quest giver in the small house at the Writhing Haunt in the Western Plaguelands. He is a member of the Cenarion Circle, on the verge of death after failing to protect the region's wildlife from the Scourge. He asks players to cleanse the forest of the diseased and dying creatures.

Mullan clan.text: The Mullan clan, or Clan Mullan, is a small clan of Wildhammer dwarf gryphon riders.

Murloc.text: Aaaaaughibbrgubugbugrguburgle! Murlocs are a bipedal, amphibious race that live along coastlines, lakeshores and riverbeds. They live in crowded settlements, and you rarely find one wandering far from the others. Brann Bronzebeard says murlocs are smarter than people think, smart enough not to let it show.

Mushgog.text: Mushgog is a rare bog beast, a level 60 elite, found in the central arena in Dire Maul.

Mutant Tentacle.text: The Mutant Goblin in the Secret Lab has two Mutant Tentacles that fight alongside him. They stay after he is defeated and have to be dealt with too.

Naga.text: The naga are serpentine, and among the most dangerous of Azeroth's villains. They're skilled sorcerers, and were once Highborne night elves in Queen Azshara's court, during the age of the Kaldorei Empire. The War of the Ancients and the destruction of the Well of Eternity transformed them into naga.

Nal'taszar.text: Nal'taszar is a rare faerie dragon found in the innermost room of Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Narm Skychaser.text: Narm Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer located in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He directs shaman adventurers to Kranal Fiss.

Naxxramas Follower.text: Naxxramas Followers are humans found in Naxxramas, as part of the Grand Widow Faerlina encounter. They are best killed as soon as possible.

Nazz Steamboil.text: Nazz Steamboil was the pilot of the goblin racer in the Mirage Raceway. The [Goblin Rumors] item says he went into hiding after stealing a small fortune from his family's hoard, and that he's the son of a Trade Prince.

Nefarian (tactics).text: Nefarian is located atop Blackwing Lair after Chromaggus. He has two forms: his human form, Lord Victor Nefarius, and his dragon form, Nefarian. Defeating him takes a full 40-man raid.

Nemas the Arbiter.text: Nemas the Arbiter is one of five ghostly paladins that spawn outside the Alonsus Chapel in Stratholme, during the final part of True Masters of the Light, a paladin charger quest. He and his four companions, along with Aurius, the chapel's "keeper," must all be defeated to complete the quest.

New Horde.text: The New Horde is the nickname for the Horde that invaded Azeroth in the Second War. It was led by veteran chieftains such as Grommash Hellscream of the Warsong clan and Kilrogg Deadeye of the Bleeding Hollow clan, under Ner'zhul's command.

Nezzliok the Dire.text: Nezzliok the Dire is a jungle troll found in Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale. Nimboya wants to know what happened to his chief's son, Yenniku, and sends adventurers to bring back Nezzliok's head so he can question it. It reveals that Zanzil the Outcast took Yenniku.

Night elf.text: Night elves, or kaldorei, meaning "children of the stars" in Darnassian, are one of the oldest races in the world. They were among the first to study magic, and their civilization once spanned ancient Kalimdor. Their war with the Burning Legion ended in the Great Sundering.

Nightbane pack.text: The Nightbane are a pack of worgen in Duskwood, once humans transformed by the worgen curse. They live mostly in Brightwood Grove, west of Darkshire, and are said to have come from Roland's Doom, a cave to the south.

Nightlash.text: Nightlash is a rare banshee found at Valgan's Field in Silverpine Forest. She leads a band of Rot Hide gnolls in the Dead Field, and wanders the center of the crop field surrounded by her minions.

Nilith Lokrav.text: Nilith Lokrav is a human quest giver located in a small camp northeast of the entrance to Blackrock Mountain in the Searing Gorge. Her infernal, Raze, helps adventurers on one of her quests.

Ninja (mob).text: Ninjas can be found on Jaguero Isle. "Dead-Eye" Drederick McGumm calls them a gang of masked hooligans who follow the Bloodsail. You can't normally see them, even with invisibility detection or hunter tracking; only the [Dead-Eye's Flare Gun] lets you see and interact with them.

Nori Pridedrift.text: Nori Pridedrift is a dwarf found in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. He sells Scalding Mornbrew, which the locals love because it comes out piping hot.

Number Two.text: Number Two is a gorilla spawned for Decoy!, part of the [Blue Scepter Shard] fork of [The Scepter of the Shifting Sands] quest chain to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

Octopus.text: Octopuses are ocean-dwelling cephalopods. Their ink is used for writing. Some night elves eat octopus meat while it's still alive.

Odo the Blindwatcher.text: Odo the Blindwatcher was already dead once. Baron Silverlaine summons him as a ghost worgen during the fight.

Oggleflint.text: Oggleflint is an elite trogg found in Ragefire Chasm.

Ogre.text: Ogres are large, brutish humanoids of notable strength, native to Draenor.

Ogre mage.text: Ogre magi are two-headed ogre spellcasters, larger and more intelligent than one-headed ogres. They often hold a higher rank among the ogre clans.

Ohgan.text: Ohgan was Bloodlord Mandokir's most trusted friend.

Old Cliff Jumper.text: Old Cliff Jumper is a rare timber wolf found around the hay stacks at Featherbeard's Hovel in the Hinterlands. He has a dark grey coat, and hunters sometimes tame him for it.

Old Horde.text: The Old Horde is the name for the orcish clans of Draenor who fought the Alliance of Lordaeron until their defeat at the end of the Second War. The faction was built on demon worship, drinking demon blood for strength, and proving your worth in combat.

Old Icebeard.text: Old Icebeard is an elite wendigo found in a cave in Chill Breeze Valley in Dun Morogh. He has a meat locker he stole from Tundra MacGrann.

Omgorn the Lost.text: Omgorn the Lost is a rare ogre found in Tanaris. He has three respawn locations, one in each ogre camp.

Onyxia.text: Onyxia is a black dragon, the daughter of Deathwing and Sintharia. She takes a human guise, the Stormwind noblewoman Lady Katrana Prestor. She is small for a black dragon her age, but a strong fighter who likes to manipulate mortal affairs in secret.

Ooze.text: Oozes, also called slimes, are mindless slime creatures. They take on something of their surroundings, which may be why there are so many kinds. Many have bones inside them, with a skull for a head.

Or'Kalar.text: Or'Kalar is an ogre found in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. Mug'thol commands him from the Alterac Mountains. He once lost a fight to Drum Fel, and Drum's wife Korin wants him dead, but attempts on his life have failed.

Orca.text: Orcas are predatory black-and-white whales found in Azerothian oceans.

Orgrimmar Defender.text: Orgrimmar Defenders are orc grunts found just inside Ragefire Chasm.

Orgrimmar Fireeater.text: Orgrimmar Fireeaters are orcs and jungle trolls found in Orgrimmar.

Owl.text: Owls are broad-faced, nocturnal birds that hunt rodents and reptiles. Unlike most birds, they have wide faces, short curved beaks, and large, front-facing eyes. Owls are found across many continents on Azeroth.

Palemane tribe.text: The Palemane are a tribe of blue-skinned gnolls in Mulgore. They live at Palemane Rock in western Mulgore, and in two camps south of Bloodhoof Village along the cliff to Red Cloud Mesa.

Pallid Horror.text: Pallid Horrors are elite wights that appeared during the Scourge Invasions, in the Undercity and Stormwind City, alongside Flameshockers. They killed city guards but were neutral to low-level characters. In Stormwind they first appeared at the Cathedral of Light; in the Undercity, in the Sewers and Trade Quarter.

Parrot.text: Parrots are birds found in tropical places. They're commonly kept by pirates, including the Defias, the Bloodsail Buccaneers, and the Blackwater Raiders. Parrots come in a range of colors, and in small and giant sizes.

Peafowl.text: Peafowl are colorful birds found on Azeroth. Adult males are called peacocks, females are peahens, and young are peachicks.

Penguin.text: Penguins are black and white flightless birds.

Pig.text: A pig is a domesticated descendant of the wild boar. Pigs are much smaller than boars, and orcs often raise them for meat on pig farms.

Plague Beast.text: Plague Beasts are bog beasts found in Naxxramas.

Plague Spreader (Duskwood).text: Plague Spreaders are ghouls found at Raven Hill in Duskwood. Three of them spawn at the border of Stranglethorn Vale if Private Merle escapes the Rebel Camp alive after finishing Patrol Schedules. They usually kill him as he tries to flee into Duskwood.

Plague-dog.text: Plague-dogs, also known as zombie dogs, are abominations made from animal parts. They're among the newer creations of the Scourge, first found stalking the corridors of Naxxramas.

Plaguefang.text: Plaguefang is a darkhound located at the Marris Stead in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Plainsland Cheetah.text: Plainsland Cheetahs are cheetahs found across the Barrens, spawning underneath trees. A Cheetah Cub sometimes appears alongside them.

Platysaur.text: Platysaurs are a type of dinosaur that have wandered the land since ancient times. For some reason, they repeat short sounds three times in a row.

Polar bear.text: Polar bears, also called arctic bears, are a species of white-pelted bear found in cold regions of Azeroth such as Dun Morogh and Winterspring.

Precious (wolf).text: Precious is a wolf that accompanies Simone the Inconspicuous in Un'Goro Crater. When Simone becomes Simone the Seductress, Precious becomes Precious the Devourer, a felhound.

Pridewing Patriarch.text: The Pridewing Patriarch is a rare wyvern found in the mountains east or south of Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. It was on a 4-6 hour respawn timer.

Pridewing Wyvern.text: Pridewing Wyverns are wyverns found at Windshear Heights in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Prince Kellen.text: Prince Kellen is a rare satyr found in Desolace. He is an easy kill for a player in their low 30s.

Prince Lakma.text: Prince Lakma is a rare chimaera that has been seen flying in the southwestern part of Feralas, across from the sunken Isle of Dread.

Private Thorsen.text: Private Thorsen is a human quest giver in the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale. He infiltrated Kurzen's force within the Stockpile with help from Bookie Herod, but was betrayed and almost killed by Private Merle.

Prospector Ironboot.text: Prospector Ironboot is a dwarf quest giver located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

Pterrordax.text: Pterrordax, also known as pterrordons or skyscreamers, are carnivorous flying dinosaurs. Their sonic screech can burst a humanoid's eardrums.

Putrid Shrieker.text: Putrid Shriekers are gargoyles found in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Pyrewood Council.text: The Pyrewood Council, led by Lord Mayor Morrison, ruled Pyrewood Village. Archmage Arugal used the council as puppets to control the village while he dealt with Shadowfang Keep. Deathstalker Faerleia believed the Sons of Arugal would turn on Arugal without the council's guidance, and asked Horde adventurers to destroy it.

Qiraji.text: The qiraji are insectoid creatures based in southern Silithus. They're organized into castes, each with its own leader: battleguards led by Battleguard Sartura, gladiators led by General Rajaxx, and prophets led by the Prophet Skeram. All castes answer to the Twin Emperors, Vek'nilash and Vek'lor.

Qiraji Major He'al-ie.text: Qiraji Major He'al-ie is a qiraji gladiator located in Silithus, Tanaris, Feralas, or Thousand Needles during the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.

Quall.text: Quall is a rare skytalon located behind Ziz Fizziks' hut in Stonetalon Mountains.

Quartermaster Kaoshin.text: Quartermaster Kaoshin is an orc quartermaster of the Blackrock Clan located in the Burning Steppes. He gives orders to the grunts, and is under General Thorg'izog's command.

Quartermaster Zigris.text: Quartermaster Zigris is an elite orc mini-boss found in Lower Blackrock Spire, up the ramp in the direction opposite the hall that leads to Halycon. He drops 5 Major Healing Potions and 5 Major Mana Potions, and sometimes carries the plans for [Annihilator].

Quilboar.text: Quilboar are a race of aggressive, boar-like humanoids native to Kalimdor, with sharp spines on their backs. They live in the central Barrens, in the maze of thorns called Razorfen Downs.

Quintis Jonespyre.text: Quintis Jonespyre was a night elf quest giver in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas, a researcher who specialized in curses. He was concerned with why Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus was using the name and resources of the Cenarion Circle to procure vast amounts of [Morrowgrain].

Ragetotem tribe.text: The Ragetotem are a tauren tribe of warriors. They serve as the warrior trainers in Thunder Bluff, and run a weapon shop there called Ragetotem Arms.

Ramstein the Gorger.text: Ramstein the Gorger is an elite abomination in the burning city of Stratholme, serving the Scourge. Like other abominations, he isn't very smart, but he's tough. He's fearless and can fight for hours without tiring.

Ranger (NPC).text: Rangers are high elves found at Quel'Lithien Lodge in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Ranshalla.text: Ranshalla is a night elf quest giver who was once at the entrance to Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring. Her current location is unknown.

Rascal Sprite.text: Rascal Sprites are grells found in Teldrassil.

Rathorian.text: Rathorian is a felguard atop Dreadmist Peak in the Barrens. He guards the [Demon Seed] and leads the cultists in the area.

Rattlegore.text: Rattlegore is a bone golem boss in Scholomance.

Ravage (hyena).text: Ravage is a rare hyena found in the Blasted Lands.

Ray.text: Rays, often called stingrays, are fish with long tails.

Raze (infernal).text: Raze is a friendly infernal in Searing Gorge and the minion of Nilith Lokrav. The tailoring quest Shadoweaver uses him and the [Staff of Command] to hunt down poachers.

Razorbeak Gryphon.text: Razorbeak Gryphon can be found in the Hinterlands.

Razorfen tribe.text: The Razorfen tribe is a tribe of quilboar led by Charlga Razorflank. They control Razorfen Kraul and Razorfen Downs, where the Ancient Guardian Agamaggan died during the War of the Ancients. The quilboar believe themselves to be his offspring.

Razormane Pathfinder.text: Razormane Pathfinders are quilboar found in the Barrens. They tame Savannah Boars into Razormane Boars.

Razormane Quilboar.text: Razormane Quilboar are quilboar of the Razormane tribe, found on the Razormane Grounds in Durotar near the Valley of Trials.

Razormane Scout.text: Razormane Scouts are quilboar of the Razormane tribe, found on the Razormane Grounds in Durotar near the Valley of Trials.

Razormane tribe.text: The Razormane are a tribe of quilboar in Durotar and the Barrens, led by Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane. They raid the Crossroads for supplies, and are at war with the Bristleback quilboar.

Razzashi Broodwidow.text: Razzashi Broodwidows are spiders found in Zul'Gurub. A hunter who tames one learns [Bite] Rank 8.

Razzashi Cobra.text: Razzashi Cobras are snakes found in Zul'Gurub. Killing one gives +1 reputation with the Zandalar Tribe.

Razzashi tribe.text: Little is known about the Razzashi tribe. They're mentioned on the Razzashi Coins found in Zul'Gurub.

Red dragonflight.text: The red dragonflight is led by Alexstrasza the Life-Binder, who the titan Eonar charged with protecting life on Azeroth. They fight to protect all life against threats like the Burning Legion.

Redpine Looter.text: Redpine Looters are gnolls located at Taelan's Tower in Western Plaguelands.

Redridge Fox Kit.text: Redridge Fox Kits are foxes found in the Redridge Mountains. They follow a mature Redridge Fox.

Redridge pack.text: The Redridge pack is a tribe of gnolls found throughout the Redridge Mountains.

Reislek's Ghost.text: Reislek's Ghost is a human ghost located at Ravenholdt in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Relwyn Shadestar.text: Relwyn Shadestar was a night elf quest giver found just inside Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale.

Restless Soul (wisp).text: Restless Souls are friendly wisps in Stratholme, the souls of Spectral Citizens and Ghostly Citizens. Shooting one with [Egan's Blaster] while it's still a citizen turns it hostile.

Retherokk the Berserker.text: Retherokk the Berserker is a rare forest troll found near the Altar of Zul in the Hinterlands.

Revantusk tribe.text: The Revantusk are a tribe of forest trolls split into two groups: one in Zul'Aman, and one on the coast of the Hinterlands. After learning of Thrall's new Horde, the Hinterlands Revantusk agreed to a pact of friendship with the Horde. Nalorakk is their main loa.

Rhahk'Zor.text: Rhahk'Zor was an ogre in the Deadmines, the foreman in charge of Edwin VanCleef's construction projects.

Ricter.text: Ricter was a Forsaken who stole a Bloodstone Marble as part of an attempt to defect from the Forsaken. Magus Wordeen Voidglare wanted the marble back.

Rigglefuzz.text: Rigglefuzz is a goblin quest giver of Booty Bay, found in a small camp in the Valley of Fangs in the Badlands.

Rilli Greasygob.text: Rilli Greasygob is a goblin located in Nogg's Machine Shop in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He used to work for the Venture Co, and his rival there was Boss Copperplug.

Ripfang tribe.text: The Ripfang are a tribe of murlocs who gather in large numbers. Yshmeel is part of the tribe and teaches its scouting and security skills.

Risen Hillsbrad Farmer.text: Risen Hillsbrad Farmers are ghouls found in Hillsbrad Foothills, along with Risen Hillsbrad Peasants. They were Hillsbrad Farmers before the Forsaken hunted them down.

Risen Protector.text: Risen Protectors are skeletons found in Scholomance.

Riverbeast.text: Riverbeasts are large, hippo-like animals found in Azeroth's waters.

Roach.text: Roaches are small insects found in the dankest corners of Azeroth. They can survive almost anything, but even they couldn't survive the demonic corruption of Felwood.

Roc.text: Rocs are giant birds created through harpy magic, and are also found among harpies. The term also covers certain eagles and vultures, like the Fire Rocs of Tanaris.

Rookery Whelp.text: Most Rookery Whelps spawn out of any eggs disturbed in the Rookery, but some may be randomly hovering in various locations in the Rookery.

Rotgrip.text: Rotgrip is a giant crocolisk boss that lives in the waters below Zaetar's Grave in Maraudon. It is usually fought after Princess Theradras, by jumping off the bridge that leads to her island.

Rotted One.text: Rotted Ones are ghouls that can be found near Raven Hill in Duskwood.

Royal Apothecary Society.text: The Royal Apothecary Society is an alchemical society created by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner to develop a new undead plague to wipe out the Scourge. Based in the Apothecarium in Undercity, its members are Forsaken and other undead who brew plagues and poisons for the Horde's enemies.

Royal Dreadguard.text: Royal Dreadguards are max level elite Forsaken Dreadguards stationed in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity, and act as the personal bodyguards of the Banshee Queen, Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. They will attack in large swarms if Sylvanas is engaged, and hit hard.

Runetotem clan.text: The Runetotem are a tauren tribe found throughout Mulgore, the Barrens, and Feralas.

Saltscale tribe.text: The Saltscale tribe is a tribe of murlocs found in the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn Vale.

Saltspittle tribe.text: The Saltspittle tribe is a tribe of murlocs found near Lake Falathim in Ashenvale.

Saltstone Basilisk.text: Saltstone Basilisks are dead basilisks found in the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles.

Saltstone Crystalhide.text: Saltstone Crystalhides are basilisks found in Thousand Needles.

Saltstone Gazer.text: Saltstone Gazers are basilisks found in Thousand Needles.

Sand Crawler.text: Sand Crawlers are crabs found on the shores in northern Westfall.

Sand reaver.text: A sand reaver is a creature that resembles a solifuge. They're found only in Ahn'Qiraj, in areas infested by the silithid.

Sand troll.text: Sand trolls are jungle trolls that live in the Tanaris desert. They adapted to the desert sun after being separated from their Eastern Kingdoms kin during the Great Sundering. The only known sand troll tribes are the Farraki, also called the Sandfury, and the Sandscalp.

Sand worm.text: Sand worms, also called bursters, are huge worm-like creatures found on Azeroth. They dig through soil quickly with claws on their upper body, then burst up beneath prey to attack with a sharp, beak-like mouth.

Sandfury Blood Drinker.text: Sandfury Blood Drinkers are sand trolls found within their capital Zul'Farrak.

Sandfury Speaker.text: The Sandfury Speaker is a sand troll found in Zul'Gurub. He is the Sandfury tribe's ambassador to the Gurubashi trolls.

Sandscraper.text: Sandscraper is the chief of the ogre Dunemaul clan. Megs Dreadshredder wants him killed. She is trying to get the Dunemaul ogres to join the Horde and doesn't want unfinished business.

Sapphiron (Classic).text: Sapphiron is the penultimate boss in Naxxramas. It was once an agent of the blue dragonflight, before Arthas Menethil raised it as a frost wyrm to guard Kel'Thuzad's chamber. Sapphiron is in the Frostwyrm Lair, reached only after the other 13 bosses in Naxxramas's four wings are dead.

Saturated Ooze.text: Saturated Oozes are oozes found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

Satyr.text: Satyrs are demons, most of them sworn to the Burning Legion. Their curse began with Xavius, a Highborne sorcerer whom Sargeras remade as a demon during the War of the Ancients. Satyrs live in sects throughout Kalimdor and harry their night elf cousins.

Scalding Elemental.text: Scalding Elementals are water elementals found in Thousand Needles.

Scarlet Bloodhound.text: Scarlet Bloodhounds are darkhounds found at New Avalon in the Eastern Plaguelands. They see through stealth.

Scarlet Champion.text: Scarlet Champions are humans of the Scarlet Crusade found inside the Cathedral wing of the Scarlet Monastery. They are paladins, but they don't heal themselves. They were the only mob to drop the [Scarlet Chestpiece], part of the Chain of the Scarlet Crusade set.

Scarlet Crusade.text: The Scarlet Crusade is a fanatical religious sect that grew out of the Order of the Silver Hand after the Third War, dedicated to wiping out the undead in Lordaeron. They're longtime enemies of the Forsaken and the Scourge, and held several strongholds in the former lands of Lordaeron, including the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades.

Scarlet Executioner.text: The Scarlet Executioner is a rare human found in the Western Plaguelands, surrounded by the bodies of gnolls.

Scarlet Flamethrower.text: Scarlet Flamethrowers are elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade found alongside Scarlet Centurions at the entrance of the Forlorn Cloister in the Scarlet Monastery. They guard a Pile of Corpses that occasionally raises Zombified Corpses.

Scarlet Footman.text: Scarlet Footmen are humans located in New Avalon in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Scarlet Friar.text: Scarlet Friars are humans found at the Crusader Outpost and Scarlet Watch Post in Tirisfal Glades. As soldiers of the Scarlet Crusade, they fight the Forsaken and the Scourge. Some are found slain at the Scarlet Encampment and the Crusader Outpost.

Scarlet inquisitor.text: Scarlet inquisitors are members of the Scarlet Crusade. They were once priests and healers, but now use the Holy Light to torture prisoners instead of healing them.

Scarlet Interrogator.text: The Scarlet Interrogator is a rare human found at Dalson's Farm in the Western Plaguelands.

Scarlet Judge.text: The Scarlet Judge is a rare human found in the Western Plaguelands, near some crates and raw unidentified meat.

Scarlet Judicator.text: Scarlet Judicators are humans of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Chapel Gardens of the Scarlet Monastery. The first ones a player meets are drunk and neutral instead of hostile.

Scarlet knight.text: Scarlet knights are ex-paladins, warriors and mounted warriors who joined the Scarlet Crusade. Some of the ex-paladins train new members who join as paladins.

Scarlet Medic.text: Scarlet Medics are human members of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Western Plaguelands.

Scarlet Myrmidon.text: Scarlet Myrmidons are humans of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Cathedral and Armory wings of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Purifier.text: Scarlet Purifiers are elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade found in the Chapel Gardens of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Smith.text: The Scarlet Smith is a rare human found in Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands.

Scarlet Torturer.text: Scarlet Torturers are elite humans of the Scarlet Crusade found inside the Graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery.

Scarlet Trooper.text: Scarlet Troopers are human paladins that escort Demetria the Scarlet Oracle. After a player accepts her quest, she and eight Scarlet Troopers spawn in Tyr's Hand and follow a fixed path through Corin's Crossing and the Plaguewoods to Stratholme, where they despawn.

Scarlet Warrior.text: Scarlet Warriors are humans of the Scarlet Crusade found at the Scarlet Palisade in northwestern Tirisfal Glades.

Scarlet Zealot.text: Scarlet Zealots are humans found at the Crusader Outpost and Scarlet Watchtower in Tirisfal Glades. They are grunt-level soldiers of the Scarlet Crusade who fight the Forsaken. Some are found slain at the Scarlet Encampment and the Crusader Outpost.

Scarshield Legion.text: The Scarshield Legion is part of Rend Blackhand's Blackrock orcs. They live in the lower levels of Blackrock Spire, where they breed and train attack worgs, and guard the way to the inner sanctum.

Scavenger Shark.text: Scavenger Sharks are sharks that patrol the waters of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

Scholar Runethorn.text: Scholar Runethorn is a night elf quest giver at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas, once an associate of the tauren Sage Korolusk. Both were looking for Telmius Dreamseeker in Dire Maul.

Scorn.text: Scorn was an elite lich boss found in Scarlet Monastery's graveyard during the Scourge Invasion. He spawns after you kill Bloodmage Thalnos.

Scorpid.text: Scorpids, also known as scorpions, are eight-legged arachnids with front claws and a curved tail that holds a sharp, poisonous stinger.

Scorpid Reaver.text: Scorpid Reavers are dead scorpids found in Thousand Needles.

Scorpid Terror.text: Scorpid Terrors are dead scorpids found in Thousand Needles.

Sea giant.text: Sea giants are giants the titans created to dredge out the seas and lift land from the ocean floor of Azeroth. The few that remain are aggressive and hostile, and known to sink ships and steal their loot.

Sea lion.text: A sea lion is an aquatic mammal with saber teeth.

Sea turtle.text: Sea turtles are large turtles with paddle-like flippers, found in the waters of Azeroth.

Seagull.text: Seagulls, or gulls, are small birds found in many coastal areas, including Stormwind City. They're coastal scavengers, often seen near the docks, and also nest in the tall grass of Durotar.

Seal.text: A seal is an amphibious, mostly water-dwelling beast or critter found along the shores of Azeroth.

Seductress Ceeyna.text: Seductress Ceeyna is a succubus that warlocks summon at the Sacrificial Altar in Shadowbreak Ravine in Desolace. The summoning ritual deals lethal damage to the warlock over 5 seconds unless they mitigate it.

Seer Graytongue.text: Seer Graytongue was a tauren quest giver found in Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore.

Sethir the Ancient.text: Sethir the Ancient is a satyr on a branch of Teldrassil, north of the Oracle Glade. He is one of the few satyrs considered humanoid, which lets players pick his pockets for a quest.

Sever (abomination).text: Sever was an abomination mini-boss found in Shadowfang Keep during the Scourge Invasion. He sits in a square room along the corridor that runs parallel to the Great Hall and Kitchen in Shadowfang Keep.

Shadow Charger.text: Shadow Chargers are elite skeletal horses found in Shadowfang Keep.

Shadow Council.text: The Shadow Council is a cult of mortal warlocks that serves the Burning Legion. Gul'dan, the first orcish warlock, founded it. Since the Great Wars, the Shadow Council has grown to include many races and split into several groups working for the Legion across Azeroth.

Shadowclaw.text: Shadowclaw is a rare nightsaber found in Darkshore. He is normally stealthed, and is found north of Auberdine, in the Withering Thicket. Use of cheap AoE skills such as [Arcane Explosion] can help when seeking him out.

Shadowfang pack.text: The Shadowfang pack is a group of worgen at Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest.

Shadowforge Ambusher.text: Shadowforge Ambushers are Dark Iron dwarves found in Uldaman.

Shadowforge clan.text: The Shadowforge clan is a family of Dark Iron dwarves, part of the larger Dark Iron clan. The earliest known member was Iron Thane Shadowforge, a cruel despot who tortured and killed many of his own people.

Shadowmoon clan.text: The Shadowmoon clan was a peaceful, spiritual and shamanistic orcish clan. Their last known chieftain, Ner'zhul, was deceived by the warlock Gul'dan and the demon lord Kil'jaeden into helping found the first Horde. After the Horde's defeat in the Second War, the Shadowmoon became the most powerful orc clan remaining on Draenor, when Ner'zhul rallied the scattered clans under his own banner.

Shadowsworn Warlock.text: Shadowsworn Warlocks are human and undead warlocks found at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands.

Shadra.text: Elortha no Shadra, or simply Shadra, is a spider loa described as a "spirit of darkness and death". Her followers use her venom as a powerful poison for their weapons. Her worshipers include the Witherbark and Vilebranch tribes in the Hinterlands, the Sandfury trolls in Zul'Farrak, and the Gurubashi trolls in Zul'Gurub.

Shark.text: Sharks are large, fish-like aquatic beasts. They are solitary predators found in every sea of Azeroth, and nearly all of them are aggressive. Sharks have no true bones, only cartilage.

Shazzrah.text: Shazzrah is a flamewaker who followed Ragnaros into Azeroth, and the most skilled of them in the arcane. He knows his colleague Baron Geddon suspects the elemental Garr of treachery, and that rivalry suits him. He wants both halves of the Talisman of Elemental Binding, to use its power for himself.

Sheep.text: Sheep are woolly, domesticated bovids. They're found in pastoral areas across the Eastern Kingdoms, including Elwynn Forest, Loch Modan, the Redridge Mountains and Hillsbrad Foothills. During the Second and Third Wars, they were common in Lordaeron, but most there have since died.

Sian-Rotam.text: Sian-Rotam is a rare frostsaber found in Winterspring. He comes to the aid of his mate Shy-Rotam during the quest Shy-Rotam.

Silithid Harvester.text: The Silithid Harvester is a rare silithid scarab found in the Barrens.

Silithid scarab.text: Silithid scarabs are beetles, part of a caste of the silithid. They're often found in and outside the hives. Many aren't aggressive unless they, or another silithid nearby, are attacked.

Silithid Swarmer.text: Silithid Swarmers are silithid workers found in the Barrens.

Siln Skychaser.text: Siln Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

Silverwing Emissary.text: Silverwing Emissaries are night elf Warsong Gulch recruiters found in Alliance cities such as Stormwind City.

Simmering Elemental.text: Simmering Elementals appear after opening the Old Chest in Feralas.

Sin'Dall.text: Sin'Dall is a rare tiger in Stranglethorn Vale. Nesingwary's Expedition has hunted her without success, and some of the hunters have died trying.

Singer.text: Singer is a rare human who roams the farm at Northfold Manor in the Arathi Highlands. She is on a 5 to 8 hour respawn timer in Classic.

Sir Maximus Adams.text: Sir Maximus Adams is an Arathi Basin battlemaster at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.

Sir Zeliek.text: Sir Zeliek is one of the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas. He was a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand in life. Kel'Thuzad commands his body, but he keeps his sanity and morals despite the corruption.

Sister Riven.text: Sister Riven is a rare harpy found east of the Charred Vale in Stonetalon Mountains.

Skarr the Broken.text: Skarr the Broken is a rare ogre found in the Lower Wilds of Feralas, north of the Razza.

Skeletal hound.text: Skeletal hounds are undead wolves and dogs, risen through death, fel or void magic.

Skeletal Shadowcaster.text: Skeletal Shadowcasters are skeletons spawned by the Skeletal Summoners in the Spiral of Thorns in Razorfen Downs.

Skeletal Steed.text: Skeletal Steeds are skeletal horses found in Naxxramas.

Skeletal Summoner.text: Skeletal Summoners are skeletal mages found in Razorfen Downs. They can summon more skeletons to help them fight.

Skeletal Warder.text: Skeletal Warders are skeletal warriors located inside the Dawning Woods Catacombs in Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood.

Skeleton.text: Skeletons are undead raised by necromancy, often used as fodder or shock troops. They look frail but can be very strong and hard to hurt. Some keep their minds and fight with weapons and magic.

Skeleton (mob).text: Skeletons are summoned by Lord Maldazzar in the Western Plaguelands, and by Gordunni Soulreapers.

Skullsplitter Panther.text: Skullsplitter Panthers are panthers found in Stranglethorn Vale. They are the pets of Skullsplitter trolls.

Slark.text: Slark is a rare murloc found patrolling the Longshore coast in Westfall with Brack. He moves fast and is hard to catch alone. He is on a 1.5 to 2.5 hour respawn timer.

Slave Master Blackheart.text: Slave Master Blackheart is a rare Dark Iron dwarf found in the Slag Pit in the Searing Gorge. He has a respawn timer of about 5 to 8 hours.

Slavering Ghoul.text: Slavering Ghouls are ghouls found in the Western Plaguelands, at Sorrow Hill and Felstone Field. Once human subjects of Lordaeron, they are basic footsoldiers of the Scourge.

Smolderthorn Shadow Priest.text: Smolderthorn Shadow Priests are forest trolls found in Hordemar City in Lower Blackrock Spire.

Snake.text: Snakes, also known as serpents, are legless reptilian beasts and critters found all across Azeroth. They come in a variety of subtypes, such as cobras, pythons and vipers.

Snapjaw.text: Snapjaws are turtles found in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Sneed.text: Sneed is an elite goblin found in the Mast Room in the Deadmines. Sneed is Edwin VanCleef's lumbermaster and pilots Sneed's Shredder.

Somnus.text: Somnus is an elite green drake found in the Swamp of Sorrows. He is an ancient champion of the green dragonflight.

Sorcerer Ashcrombe.text: Sorcerer Ashcrombe is an elite human imprisoned in Shadowfang Keep, near Deathstalker Adamant's cell. After Rethilgore is defeated, Alliance players can ask Ashcrombe to open the gate to the rest of the instance.

Sorrowmurk Snapjaw.text: Sorrowmurk Snapjaws are turtles found in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Soulflayer.text: Soulflayers are wind serpents found in Zul'Gurub.

Soulless Ghoul.text: Soulless Ghouls are ghouls found around the Ruins of Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

Southsea Cannoneer.text: Southsea Cannoneers are humans and Dark Iron dwarves found on the Merchant Coast in the Barrens.

Southsea Cutthroat.text: Southsea Cutthroats are humans, jungle trolls, and Dark Iron dwarves. Two are imprisoned at the Merchant Coast in the Barrens.

Southsea Strongarm.text: Southsea Strongarms are humans located in Southbreak Shore in Tanaris.

Southshore Crier.text: Nobody knows when the Southshore Crier will show up in Southshore. When he does, he yells a warning about assassins, and Shadowy Assassins spawn right after.

Sparkleshell Snapper.text: Sparkleshell Snappers are turtles native to the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

Spawn of Fankriss.text: Spawn of Fankriss are found in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, as part of the Fankriss the Unyielding encounter.

Spazzranache.text: Spazzranache is a critter tallstrider in Mulgore, one of Mazzranache's fledglings.

Spectral Apparition.text: Spectral Apparitions are found in level 1-10 zones near the capital cities, including Elwynn Forest and Teldrassil.

Spectral Soldier.text: Spectral Soldiers are wraiths located in several areas of the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.

Spell Eater (dragon whelp).text: Spell Eaters are blue whelps located in Winterspring.

Spire Scorpid.text: Spire Scorpids are scorpids found in Lower Blackrock Spire.

Spirestone clan.text: The Spirestone clan of ogres follows the Dark Horde, led by Rend Blackhand and his brother Maim at Blackrock Mountain. Led by Highlord Omokk, they make up a large part of the forces in Blackrock Spire.

Spirit of Trey Lightforge.text: The Spirit of Trey Lightforge is a human ghost found in Felwood. He spawns near the end of the quest Rescue From Jaedenar.

Spitelash Raider.text: Spitelash Raiders are naga located in Azshara.

Spitelash Witch.text: Spitelash Witches are naga located in Azshara.

Squid.text: Squids are tentacled, water-dwelling creatures found in the seas of Azeroth.

Squirrel.text: Squirrels are small, furry rodents found in wooded areas around Azeroth. Most hoard acorns for food.

Starfish.text: Starfish, or sea stars, are star-shaped invertebrates. They come in many colors.

Starving Dire Wolf.text: Starving Dire Wolves are dire wolves found in Duskwood. They have a larger aggro radius than the other wolves and spiders in the area.

Steelsnap.text: Steelsnap is a hyena in Thousand Needles. Melor Stonehoof wants it killed, and it patrols near Feralas with two other hyenas.

Stonard Explorer.text: Stonard Explorers are orcs found wandering in Swamp of Sorrows.

Stonard Scout.text: Stonard Scouts are orcs that patrol the roads west and south of Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Stone Golem (Badlands).text: Stone Golems are golems found in the Badlands.

Stonearm.text: Stonearm is a rare centaur found roaming the Kolkar camps around the Forgotten Pools. He is on a 1.5-2.5 hour respawn timer.

Stonemaul clan.text: The Stonemaul clan is an ogre clan that was allied with the orcs. After the Second War, it split in two: one part sailed west to Kalimdor and settled in Dustwallow Marsh, while the other stayed in Lordaeron.

Stonespine.text: Stonespine is an elite rare gargoyle that occasionally spawns in Stratholme in place of the Rockwing Gargoyles or Rockwing Screechers, patrolling the same area they do.

Stonesplinter Trogg.text: Stonesplinter Troggs are troggs found in Stonesplinter Valley in Loch Modan.

Stonetalon centaur.text: The Stonetalon centaur were a group of centaur that lived in the Stonetalon Mountains. During the Third War, the Horde attacked them to claim their Khan's Glyph of Purification, needed to cure a befouled fountain, which seemingly destroyed the group.

Storm Shadowhoof.text: Storm Shadowhoof is a tauren quest giver in Everlook in Winterspring. He was originally found at Bloodvenom Falls.

Stormpike clan.text: The Stormpike clan is a respected dwarven clan known for its fine tastes. They're wealthy, with an eye for excellence, and don't like being bothered with trivial matters.

Stormpike Emissary.text: Stormpike Emissaries are dwarf Alterac Valley recruiters found in Stormwind City.

Stormreaver clan.text: The Stormreaver clan was a small but powerful orc clan that Gul'dan created at the start of the Second War. Most of the clan died when Gul'dan went to the Tomb of Sargeras, torn apart by demons there or later hunted down for abandoning the Horde. A few remnants survived, scattered in covens or living as hermits.

Stormscale tribe.text: The Stormscale naga live in Darkshore, at the Ruins of Mathystra and in the caves at Cliffspring Falls.

Stormwind Army.text: The Stormwind Army is the main military force of the Kingdom of Stormwind, and a major part of the Alliance's forces. The Stormwind Fleet supports it in transport and coastal warfare, and it deputizes Alliance heroes for certain duties.

Stormwind Elite.text: Stormwind Elites are the fighting elite of Stormwind's guard. They also appear in Stormwind Harbor during the Scourge Invasion.

Stormwind Firebreather.text: Stormwind Firebreathers are humans found in Stormwind City.

Strange Winged Goblin.text: Strange Winged Goblins are goblin cupids that appear in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City, disguised as a Lovely Reveler or a Suspicious Crate, and in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest during the Love is in the Air event.

Stromic army.text: The Stromic army is the main military force of the human kingdom of Stromgarde. It has a long history of fighting the forest trolls, and its soldiers held off the Orcish Horde on their own during the Second War, giving the rest of the Alliance of Lordaeron time to mobilize.

Subject Four.text: Subject Four wanders the burning buildings of the Secret Lab. He was bred with Subject Nine to create a race of superior raptors.

Succubus.text: Succubi are seductive and sadistic demons. Many serve the Burning Legion, and some serve a warlock. Kil'jaeden brought them into the Legion to spy on worlds it meant to conquer.

Sul'lithuz Hatchling.text: Sul'lithuz Hatchlings are baby basilisks found in a cage in the cave where Antu'sul resides, in Zul'Farrak. They grow into Sul'lithuz sandcrawlers and abominations.

Sulfuron Harbinger.text: Sulfuron Harbinger is a flamewaker in the Molten Core and a herald of Ragnaros. He commands Ambassador Flamelash and the other flamewakers, and answers only to Executus. He guards the rune of Koro, one of several runes that empower the Firelord's servants.

Swiftmane.text: Swiftmane is an elite rare zhevra found just above Ratchet in the Barrens. He runs faster than a normal mount, and can outrun even an epic one.

Syndicate.text: The Syndicate is a human criminal organization led by nobles of the fallen kingdom of Alterac. After the Third War, it based itself in Strahnbrad and operated across the Arathi Highlands and Alterac Mountains, with small camps in the Hillsbrad Foothills. It's an enemy of both the Alliance, especially Stromgarde, and the Horde, and a rival of Ravenholdt.

Takk the Leaper.text: Takk the Leaper is an elite rare raptor found roaming the ridge southeast of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. It's on a 4-6 hour respawn timer and known for its speed.

Tallstrider.text: Tallstriders, also known as plainstriders or striders, are large flightless birds native to Kalimdor.

Talonbranch pack.text: The Talonbranch are a pack of worgen who live in Talonbranch Glade.

Tarkreu Shadowstalker.text: Tarkreu Shadowstalker is an orc located at Ironstone Camp in Thousand Needles. He seems to be a member of the orcish war party led by Moktar Krin.

Tauren.text: The tauren, or shu'halo in their own language, are a race of large bovine humanoids who live on the plains of central Kalimdor. For generations, violent centaur forced them into a nomadic life in the Barrens. During the Third War, Warchief Thrall and the New Horde helped drive the centaur from the tauren's sacred lands in Mulgore.

Techbot.text: Techbot is a crowd pummeler near the Workshop Door in Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh. Tinkmaster Overspark created it to store information.

Tempered War Golem.text: Tempered War Golems are stone golems that patrol the Searing Gorge.

Temple Rat.text: Temple Rats are rats in the Temple of Bethekk in Zul'Gurub. They can be given to Prides of Bethekk to make them enrage, as part of [Here, Kitty Kitty...].

Terrowulf pack.text: The Terrowulf were a pack of worgen in the Howling Vale in Ashenvale. The Terrowulf Packlord seems to be the last of the pack.

Terrowulf Packlord.text: The Terrowulf Packlord is a rare worgen found in the Howling Vale of Ashenvale, on a 21-32 hour respawn timer. He's usually on his hands and knees on a ledge, looking dazed.

Tethis.text: Tethis is a raptor found north of the Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale. It's known to terrorize the area.

Thaddius.text: Thaddius is the fourth and final boss of the Construct Quarter in Naxxramas.

Thane Korth'azz.text: Thane Korth'azz is one of the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas. He commands fire, and can call meteors down from the sky. He may have fallen to the Scourge after Uther the Lightbringer's death, and might once have been a member of the Knights of the Silver Hand.

Thaurissan family.text: Thaurissan is the royal family of the Dark Iron dwarf clan. Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan ruled the Dark Irons during the War of the Three Hammers and summoned Ragnaros into Azeroth.

Thaurissan Firewalker.text: Thaurissan Firewalkers are Dark Iron dwarves found in the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes. They're random spawns on a 3-5 minute respawn timer, shared with Thaurissan Spies and Thaurissan Agents.

The Abominable Greench.text: The Abominable Greench is an elite yeti and the main boss of the Feast of Winter Veil. He has stolen treats from Smokywood Pastures and hidden them in his lair, Growless Cave in the Alterac Mountains, along with Metzen the Reindeer. He's served by Rotten Little Helpers who are fed up with working for Greatfather Winter.

The Black Bishop.text: The Black Bishop is a human affiliated with the Twilight's Hammer. He talks as though he's playing chess, calling you a pawn.

The Duke of Zephyrs.text: The Duke of Zephyrs is a wind serpent, and one of the Elemental Nobles of the Abyssal Council. The Cenarion Circle believes he and the other three Dukes are behind the Twilight's Hammer cultists in Silithus.

The Lanticore.text: The Lanticore is a hydra-like creature that very rarely spawns in the Rookery in Upper Blackrock Spire.

The Lone Hunter.text: The Lone Hunter is a ghost wolf with Joseph Redpath's hunting blade still stuck in its skull. His daughter, Pamela Redpath, asks players to get it back for her father.

The Seven.text: The Seven were Dark Iron dwarves of great knowledge and power, the patriarchs of the Dark Iron nation. Along with Thaurissan, they summoned Ragnaros the Firelord to Azeroth. They died in the summoning and their people were enslaved by Ragnaros, but they seem to think the Firelord's coming was a blessing.

Thistlefur tribe.text: The Thistlefur tribe is a tribe of hostile, corrupted furbolgs in Ashenvale. They live mainly in Thistlefur Hold in west-central Ashenvale and in Thistlefur Village to the south.

Thorium Brotherhood.text: The Thorium Brotherhood is a group of Dark Iron dwarves who left the Dark Iron clan. They're based at Thorium Point, on cliffs above the Cauldron in northern Searing Gorge, where they keep watch on Dark Iron activity.

Threshadon.text: A threshadon, or thresher, is a large, long-necked aquatic reptile found in the watery areas of Darkshore. They produce ambergris.

Thug.text: A group of Thugs can be found behind the farmhouse of Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall. They stay neutral until you try to eavesdrop on their conversation, then turn hostile.

Thunder Bluff Fireeater.text: Thunder Bluff Fireeaters were jungle trolls located in Thunder Bluff.

Thunder lizard.text: Thunder lizards are large, heavy-set reptiles with lightning abilities. They're found in the Barrens, Desolace, Durotar and the Stonetalon Mountains in Kalimdor.

Thunderhorn clan.text: The Thunderhorn clan is a clan of tauren with hunters and warriors among their ranks. They have a well in Mulgore.

Thuzadin Necromancer.text: Thuzadin Necromancers are hardened graduates of the Scholomance, found in Stratholme. Killing them gives +1 reputation with the Argent Dawn.

Tigor Skychaser.text: Tigor Skychaser is a tauren shaman trainer located on Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

Timberling.text: Timberlings are bog beast-like creatures found in Teldrassil, described as elementals of nature. In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on Teldrassil, but they've become corrupted and aggressive from [Fel Moss].

Timbermaw Shaman.text: Timbermaw Shaman are furbolgs found in Azshara's section of Timbermaw Hold and in Ursolan. Killing them lowers your reputation with the Timbermaw Hold faction.

Timbermaw tribe.text: The Timbermaw tribe are furbolgs in Felwood, uncorrupted by the taint that plagues the zone. The Deadwood tribe, their sworn enemies, were driven mad by that taint.

Tony Two-Tusk.text: Tony Two-Tusk is a jungle troll pirate found on Fray Island in the Barrens.

Toothsmash the Annihilator.text: Toothsmash the Annihilator is an ogre located at the Dreadmaul Post in Blasted Lands. He leads the Dreadmaul tribe.

Torchbelcher tribe.text: The Torchbelcher tribe is an ogre tribe allied with the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. They provide the Dragonmaw with warriors and mages.

Tormented Spirit.text: The Tormented Spirit is a rare banshee found patrolling the northwestern edge of the Agamand Mills in Tirisfal Glades, on a 1 to 2 hour respawn timer. Her appearance may be linked to the Lost Souls that appear nearby.

Torn Fin tribe.text: The Torn Fin tribe is a tribe of murlocs in the Hillsbrad Foothills. They're involved in the quest Elixir of Agony.

Tortusk.text: Tortusk is a quilboar and the leader of the Razormane tribe around Thorn Hill. He fights mounted on his raptor, Fez.

Toxic Horror.text: Toxic Horrors are water elementals corrupted by the Burning Legion's invasion of Felwood. The Deadwood furbolgs gather their toxin to fight other furbolg tribes in the area. Toxic Horrors are immune to Frost damage.

Treant Avatar.text: The Treant Avatar is a treant that appears near the Shrine of the Warden in the High Wilderness in Feralas. A druid summons it by interacting with the shrine to gain Duty of the Warden, then casting [Remove Curse] and [Cure Poison] on themselves to turn it into Mark of the Warden.

Trigore the Lasher.text: Trigore the Lasher is a rare hydra found in the Cavern of Mists in the Barrens, swimming near the entrance to the Wailing Caverns. It has fought and beaten every challenger, including many adventurers and Alliance and Horde warriors alike. Orc younglings who try to kill it for the Blessing of the Clan have all died instead.

Trogg.text: The troggs are a race of brutish, cave-dwelling humanoids. Known for their low intelligence, they often come into conflict with their distant dwarven relatives.

Troll.text: Trolls, collectively called trollkind, are a diverse race found in every part of Azeroth. Most trolls are loyal only to their own tribe, but some tribes have joined the Horde in recent years.

Tunnel Rat Lackey.text: Tunnel Rat Lackey is a kobold located in Loch Modan. After Bluegill Representatives killed the Mosshide Representative, the lackey escaped.

Turkey.text: Turkeys are a species of bird. They're eaten during the Feast of Winter Veil. Wild turkeys can fly; domesticated ones can't.

Turtle.text: Turtles are slow-moving reptiles with a hard shell that protects their body. Different species are found all over Azeroth.

Twilight Council.text: The Twilight Council appears to be a leading group in the Twilight's Hammer. Its members are called Lords of the Twilight Council. Only they may speak to the Lords of the Abyssal Council.

Twilight Keeper Exeter.text: Twilight Keeper Exeter is a human. Twilight's Hammer cultists carry papers with gibberish written on them, which their scribes decode using a book called the Twilight Lexicon.

Twilight Keeper Havunth.text: Twilight Keeper Havunth is an orc found in Silithus. Twilight's Hammer cultists carry papers with gibberish written on them, which their scribes decode using a book called the Twilight Lexicon.

Twilight Keeper Mayna.text: Twilight Keeper Mayna is a human. Twilight's Hammer cultists carry papers with gibberish written on them, which their scribes decode using a book called the Twilight Lexicon.

Twilight Lord Bathiel.text: Twilight Lord Bathiel is a water ascendant boss found in the Moonshrine Sanctum of Blackfathom Deeps. His first order was to throw his sire, Twilight Lord Kelris, into Aku'mai's jaws. He raised the hydra by drawing on the elements more than any shaman would dare.

Twilight Master.text: Twilight Masters are Twilight mobs located at the Twilight Outpost in southwestern Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab, they can drop pieces of the Twilight set, used to summon bosses.

Ukor.text: Ukor is an orc peon on the path east of the Valley of Trials in Durotar. He carried a bundle of food from Razor Hill to the Valley of Trials, but the camp didn't need it, so he asks you to carry the food back to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn.

Un'Goro Gorilla.text: Un'Goro Gorillas are gorillas found at Fungal Rock in Un'Goro Crater. They call for help when their health drops under 25%, so it's best to pull them away from other gorillas nearby.

Una Ji'ro.text: Una Ji'ro was a jungle troll of the Shatterspear tribe, found in Shatterspear Vale. Her fate after the night elf assault on the village is unknown.

Undead.text: The undead are former mortals who died, their souls trapped between life and death. They draw power from necromantic energy that runs through the universe. Most are driven by hatred for the living.

Undead Scarab.text: Undead Scarabs are undead carrion beetles summoned by Nerub'enkan in Stratholme. They have a red and teal appearance.

Undercity Fireeater.text: Undercity Fireeaters are Forsaken found in the Undercity.

United tauren tribes.text: The united tauren tribes are the tauren nation of Kalimdor and a member of the Horde. Led by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, they founded Thunder Bluff as their capital on a mesa in Mulgore.

Unseen.text: Unseen are invisible mobs that haunt Raven Hill in Duskwood and the Ruins of Lordaeron in Undercity. They are neutral unless attacked. Warlocks can see them with the [Detect Invisibility] spell.

Unstoppable Abomination.text: Unstoppable Abominations are abominations summoned in Kel'Thuzad's Chamber during the Kel'Thuzad encounter in Naxxramas.

Venomclaw.text: Venomclaw is a rare scorpid found on a plateau in Thousand Needles.

Venomhide Ravasaur (mob).text: Venomhide Ravasaurs are ravasaurs found in Un'Goro Crater. Fighting one can imbue your weapon with poison that deals nature damage over time.

Venture Company.text: The Venture Company, often called Venture Co., is a goblin cartel known for plundering Azeroth's natural resources. If it can be dug up, chopped down or blown out of a mountain, they'll take it.

Vicious Gray Bear.text: Vicious Gray Bears are gray bears found at Tarren Mill vs Southshore.

Vile Fin tribe.text: The Vile Fin tribe is a tribe of murlocs found in Tirisfal Glades and Silverpine Forest. Their spawning grounds are off Tirisfal's northern coast.

Vilebranch tribe.text: The Vilebranch tribe is a forest troll tribe in the Hinterlands. They're a depraved lot who feed on other trolls and humanoids, and their strongest members worship the loa Hakkar the Soulflayer.

Vilefang.text: Vilefang is a snake found in the Wailing Caverns.

Viscidus.text: Viscidus is an optional boss in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj, a giant slime that can be reached after the death of Fankriss the Unyielding. He requires high Nature Resistance, since his poison bolts deal both direct and ongoing damage. He resets if taken outside his room, like the bosses in Zul'Gurub.

Viscous Fallout.text: Viscous Fallout is an elite water elemental mini-boss found in Gnomeregan. After he is defeated, the [Hydrocane] is recovered and returned to Tinker Town in Ironforge.

Voidwalker.text: Voidwalkers are large, shapeless creatures of the void in shades of blue and purple, and they hover in the air. Their grip can crush bone to powder. A spellcaster's bindings keep a voidwalker from harming anyone without leave.

Voriya.text: Voriya was a level 56 female jungle troll found in Shatterspear Vale in Classic. She was part of the Shatterspear tribe.

Wailing Mary Smitts.text: Wailing Mary Smitts is a worgen found aboard the Riptide in Stranglethorn Vale.

Walking Bomb.text: Walking Bombs are the explosive protectors that Mekgineer Thermaplugg's bomb machines produce when he's threatened, in Gnomeregan. He starts the machines with a bolt of electricity from his mechanical battle-mount.

Wallaby.text: Wallaby is a pug found in Redridge Pass in Redridge Mountains, during the quest Tracking Tipoff. If Hunter McAlister is killed first, Wallaby runs away.

Wandering Protector.text: The Wandering Protector is an ancient that patrols the area east of Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale Forest.

Warden Belamoore.text: Warden Belamoore is a human mage from Dalaran found in the Alterac Mountains.

Wardens of the Dream.text: The Wardens of the Dream, Dreamscythe and Weaver, spawn in the central room of Zul'Gurub after Jammal'an the Prophet and Ogom the Wretched are killed.

Warlock clan.text: The Warlock clans were groups of orcish warlocks mentioned from before the First War. Gul'dan wrote of them as separate from the Shadow Council. Orgrim Doomhammer wiped them out, and Gul'dan replaced them with death knights.

Warlord Krellian.text: Warlord Krellian is a naga found in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara. He leads the Spitelash Naga and defeated a Horde platoon led by Sergeant Dynamo.

Warlord Thresh'jin.text: Warlord Thresh'jin is a forest troll found atop the temple of Mazra'Alor in Zul'Mashar in the Eastern Plaguelands. He took leadership of the Mossflayer tribe from Vex'tul, who later returned as an undead and killed him. His body was thrown into the bonfire atop the ziggurat.

Warsong Envoy.text: Warsong Envoys are orc Warsong Gulch recruiters found in Orgrimmar.

Warug.text: Warug is a centaur quest giver in Magram Village in Desolace. He leads the Magram and speaks for the clan in dealing with Horde or Alliance help against their enemy clans. He also likes gnomish inventions such as target dummies.

Warug's Target Dummy.text: Warug's Target Dummy is an advanced target dummy that Warug sets up at his camp outside Magram Village in Desolace, after you finish Gizmo for Warug. It lasts a few seconds, making Warug laugh, before it disappears.

Washte Pawne.text: Washte Pawne, called Spirit Biter in Taur-ahe, is a wind serpent native to the Barrens. It is colored red with yellow wings.

Wasp.text: Wasps are stinging insects found on Azeroth. A wide variety of silithid wasps are found across Kalimdor.

Water elemental.text: Water elementals are creatures made of water and other liquids.

Weaver.text: Weaver is a young green drake and member of the Wardens of the Dream found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He appears in the central chamber when Jammal'an the Prophet is defeated.

Webwood Spider.text: Webwood Spiders are fel-corrupted tarantulas that live in and around the Shadowthread Cave in northwestern Shadowglen.

Wendigo (mob).text: Wendigos are found inside the Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh.

Westfall murlocs.text: The Westfall murlocs live along the coast of Longshore in Westfall. They're responsible for the deaths of people at the Westfall Lighthouse.

Wetlands Crocolisk.text: Wetlands Crocolisks are crocolisks found in the Wetlands, colored blue-green.

Whirlwind Stormwalker.text: Whirlwind Stormwalkers are air elementals in Desolace. Their presence stops the Desolace oasis from spreading its plants, so Karnum Marshweaver has adventurers kill them.

White Chicken.text: White Chickens are chicken critters found in Orgrimmar.

Wild Grell.text: Wild Grells are grells that appear at Bashal'Aran in Darkshore.

Wild Horse.text: Wild Horses are horses found in eastern Gilneas, eastern Hillsbrad Foothills, and western Arathi Highlands.

Wild Turkey.text: Wild Turkeys are turkeys found in Elwynn Forest and Tirisfal Glades.

Wildhammer clan.text: The Wildhammer clan is a dwarf clan based mainly in the Hinterlands. They are known as gryphon riders. High Thane Falstad Wildhammer leads them.

Wildhammer dwarf.text: Wildhammer dwarves are a type of dwarf based mainly in the Hinterlands. They're known for their close bond with gryphons, treating them as equals in battle rather than pets. They value nature and have close ties to shamanism.

Wildmane clan.text: The Wildmane clan is a tauren clan with a strong connection to nature and animals. Many of them are druids, while others train wind riders or make leather armor.

Wildpaw tribe.text: The Wildpaw tribe is a tribe of gnolls in Alterac Valley. An avalanche buried most of the ridge they once controlled, killing much of their population, and now they live only in Wildpaw Cavern, a nuisance to the Horde at Frostwolf Village.

Wildspawn Satyr.text: Wildspawn Satyrs are satyrs located in Dire Maul.

William Kielar.text: William Kielar is a human ghost and spectral gryphon flight master located at the Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands. If a faction captured all four original towers, Kielar would spawn for that faction and offer free, one-way shortcuts to the tower of their choice.

Wind serpent.text: Wind serpents are brightly colored, winged serpents with a feathered head.

Windfury harpies.text: The Windfuries are a group of blue-white harpies found in Mulgore. They're natural enemies of the tauren, who use their feathers for headdresses.

Winna's Kitten.text: Winna's Kitten is a house cat found alongside Winna Hazzard in Felwood. Winna used it to test water from a corrupted moonwell during Well of Corruption, and the water transformed it into the Corrupted Cat.

Winter Wolf.text: Winter Wolves are frost wolves found on the eastern side of Chill Breeze Valley in Dun Morogh.

Winterax tribe.text: The Winterax tribe is a tribe of ice trolls led by Korrak the Bloodrager. They are cannibals.

Winterfall tribe.text: The Winterfall tribe of furbolgs live in the snowy mountains of Winterspring. Most have white fur, adapted to their environment, though some have brown fur like other tribes. Their largest settlement, Winterfall Village, is in the east of Winterspring near Everlook, and is home to their chieftain, High Chief Winterfall.

Winterhoof tribe.text: The Winterhoof tribe are a tauren clan who specialize in alchemy and herbalism. Most live in Thunder Bluff, and they run a totem shop there called Winterhoof Totems.

Wisp.text: Wisps are ancient spirits of nature that live in the forests of Kalimdor. They are the spirits of dead night elves who have become one with the forest.

Witchwing Ambusher.text: Witchwing Ambushers are found in the Dry Hills of the Barrens. They roam around sneaking.

Witherbark Axe Thrower.text: Witherbark Axe Throwers are forest trolls found at Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands.

Witherbark Fisher.text: Witherbark Fishers are forest trolls found in Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands.

Witherbark Headhunter.text: Witherbark Headhunters are forest trolls found at Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands.

Witherbark tribe.text: The Witherbark tribe, also called the Witherbark Trolls or Basengo, is a forest troll tribe in the Hinterlands.

Witherbark Witch Doctor.text: Witherbark Witch Doctors are forest trolls found at Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands.

Withered Spearhide.text: Withered Spearhides are quilboar found early in Razorfen Downs.

Witherheart the Stalker.text: Witherheart the Stalker is a rare forest troll found at Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands. He uses stealth.

Wolf.text: Wolves are furry, carnivorous canines that often run in packs. They live on every known continent, with a wide variety of subspecies and social habits.

Wolf Master Nandos.text: Wolf Master Nandos is a ghost worgen, summoned by Baron Silverlaine when his health drops to about half.

Wolfguard Worg.text: Wolfguard Worgs are worgs found in Shadowfang Keep. They can also be summoned by Shadowfang Wolfguards.

Woodpaw clan.text: The Woodpaw clan is a clan of gnolls native to Feralas. They're found in the northeastern and southeastern parts of the zone.

Worgen.text: Worgen are large, lupine humanoids that walk upright but hunt and howl like wolves, and drop to all fours to run. They mainly live in forests. Being bitten by a worgen, or drinking its blood, transmits the worgen curse and turns humans and night elves into one.

Wyvern.text: A wyvern, also known as a wind rider or war rider, is a sentient, lion-like creature with bat wings and a scorpion tail, native to Kalimdor. They can speak and understand Orcish and Taur-ahe, but not Common. Both males and females have manes.

Yeh'kinya.text: Yeh'kinya is a jungle troll quest giver located at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

Yeti.text: Yetis, also known as wendigo, are large, cannibalistic and savage. Some are solitary and some live in tribes, usually in or near caves. They're highly territorial and don't take kindly to intruders in their hunting grounds.

Young Black Bear.text: Young Black Bears are bear cub mobs found above Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh. They sit idly in Jermaine and Anton Buckey's camp, while their Black Bear guardians chase the two dwarves up a tree.

Young Panther.text: Young Panthers are panthers found in Stranglethorn Vale.

Young Snow Leopard.text: Young Snow Leopards are snow leopards found in Dun Morogh.

Ysondre (Classic).text: Ysondre is one of the four Dragons of Nightmare.

Zalazane.text: Hexmaster Zalazane was a powerful witch doctor of the Darkspear tribe and once Vol'jin's best friend. He became the Darkspear's greatest traitor.

Zanzil the Outcast.text: Zanzil the Outcast was a Skullsplitter troll exile. In Stranglethorn Vale, he is a jungle troll found in the Ruins of Aboraz, serving as a minor villain during the Stranglethorn Vale storyline.

Zelfrax.text: Zelfrax is a demon that looks like a gargoyle. It has taken over Witch Hill in Dustwallow Marsh, raised the dead there, and is driving "Swamp Eye" Jarl mad.

Zenn Foulhoof.text: Zenn Foulhoof is a satyr located east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil.

Zevrost.text: Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. As part of a warlock quest chain, a Horde warlock needs to seek Zevrost out to get information about the Council of the Black Harvest.

Zhevra.text: Zhevra are striped, unicorn- or zebra-like beasts found in the Barrens. They're strong enough in the legs to knock a tauren off its feet, and they're rarely used as mounts because they're stubborn and tend to bite.

Zombie.text: Zombies are a kind of undead. Most are humans and trolls, but goblin and high elf zombies have been seen too.

Zulian tribe.text: The Zulian tribe is known only from the Zulian Coins found in Zul'Gurub.

Zuzubee.text: Zuzubee is an ogre located at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles.
